source.text: Ἦσαν δὲ ἐν Ἀντιοχείᾳ κατὰ τὴν οὖσαν ἐκκλησίαν προφῆται καὶ διδάσκαλοι ὅ τε Βαρναβᾶς καὶ Συμεὼν ὁ καλούμενος Νίγερ, καὶ Λούκιος ὁ Κυρηναῖος, Μαναήν τε Ἡρῴδου τοῦ τετραάρχου σύντροφος καὶ Σαῦλος.

records.literal_gloss: There were now in Antioch in the being [there] church prophets and teachers, both Barnabas and Simeon the [one] being called Niger, and Lucius the Cyrenian, Manaen also, of Herod the tetrarch brought up with, and Saul.

en.L: Now there were in Antioch, in the church that was [there], prophets and teachers: both Barnabas and Simeon, who was called Niger, and Lucius the Cyrenian, and Manaen, brought up with Herod the tetrarch, and Saul.
en.B: The church in Antioch had prophets and teachers among its members: Barnabas, Simeon known as Niger, Lucius the Cyrenian, Manaen, a childhood companion of Herod the tetrarch, and Saul.
en.R: The church in the city of Antioch had some prophets and teachers. They were Barnabas, Simeon (who was also called Niger), Lucius from Cyrene, Manaen, and Saul. Manaen had grown up with Herod, the ruler of Galilee.

es.L: Había en Antioquía, en la iglesia que estaba [allí], profetas y maestros: Bernabé, y Simeón, llamado Níger, y Lucio de Cirene, y Manaén, criado junto con Herodes el tetrarca, y Saulo.
es.B: La iglesia de Antioquía tenía entre sus miembros profetas y maestros: Bernabé, Simeón, apodado Níger, Lucio de Cirene, Manaén, que se había criado con Herodes el tetrarca, y Saulo.
es.R: La iglesia de la ciudad de Antioquía tenía algunos profetas y maestros. Eran Bernabé, Simeón (al que también llamaban Níger), Lucio, de Cirene, Manaén y Saulo. Manaén se había criado con Herodes, el gobernante de Galilea.

fr.L: Or il y avait à Antioche, dans l’église qui [s’y trouvait], des prophètes et des enseignants : Barnabas, Siméon, appelé Niger, Lucius le Cyrénéen, Manaën, élevé avec Hérode le tétrarque, et Saul.
fr.B: L’église d’Antioche comptait parmi ses membres des prophètes et des enseignants : Barnabas, Siméon, qu’on appelait Niger, Lucius de Cyrène, Manaën, compagnon d’enfance d’Hérode le tétrarque, et Saul.
fr.R: Dans l’église de la ville d’Antioche, il y avait des prophètes et des enseignants. C’étaient Barnabas, Siméon (qu’on appelait aussi Niger), Lucius de Cyrène, Manaën et Saul. Manaën avait grandi avec Hérode, celui qui gouvernait la Galilée.

sw.L: Basi katika Antiokia, katika kanisa lililokuwa [huko], kulikuwa na manabii na walimu: Barnaba, na Simeoni aliyeitwa Nigeri, na Lukio Mkirene, na Manaeni, aliyelelewa pamoja na Herode mtawala, na Sauli.
sw.B: Kanisa la Antiokia lilikuwa na manabii na walimu miongoni mwa washiriki wake: Barnaba, Simeoni aitwaye Nigeri, Lukio wa Kirene, Manaeni, aliyekua pamoja na Herode mtawala, na Sauli.
sw.R: Kanisa la mji wa Antiokia lilikuwa na manabii na walimu kadhaa. Walikuwa Barnaba, Simeoni (aliyeitwa pia Nigeri), Lukio wa Kirene, Manaeni, na Sauli. Manaeni alikuwa amekua pamoja na Herode, mtawala wa Galilaya.

vi.L: Trong Hội Thánh tại An-ti-ốt có những nhà tiên tri và giáo sư: Ba-na-ba, Si-mê-ôn gọi là Ni-giê, Lu-si-út người Sy-ren, Ma-na-hem là người được nuôi dưỡng chung với tiểu vương Hê-rốt, và Sau-lơ.
vi.B: Hội Thánh tại An-ti-ốt có những nhà tiên tri và giáo sư: Ba-na-ba, Si-mê-ôn cũng gọi là Ni-giê, Lu-si-út người Sy-ren, Ma-na-hem, bạn thuở nhỏ của tiểu vương Hê-rốt, và Sau-lơ.
vi.R: Hội Thánh tại thành An-ti-ốt có một số nhà tiên tri và giáo sư. Đó là Ba-na-ba, Si-mê-ôn (cũng gọi là Ni-giê), Lu-si-út người Sy-ren, Ma-na-hem và Sau-lơ. Ma-na-hem đã lớn lên cùng với Hê-rốt, người cai trị miền Ga-li-lê.

ko.L: 그런데 안디옥에 있는 교회에 예언자들과 교사들이 있었다. 바나바와 니게르라고 불리는 시므온과 구레네 사람 루기오와 분봉왕 헤롯과 함께 자란 마나엔과 사울이었다.
ko.B: 안디옥 교회에는 예언자들과 교사들이 있었다. 바나바와 니게르라고 하는 시므온과 구레네 사람 루기오와 분봉왕 헤롯의 어릴 적 친구 마나엔과 사울이었다.
ko.R: 안디옥이라는 도시에 있는 교회에는 예언자들과 교사들이 있었다. 그들은 바나바, 시므온(니게르라고도 불렸다), 구레네에서 온 루기오, 마나엔, 그리고 사울이었다. 마나엔은 갈릴리를 다스리던 헤롯과 함께 자란 사람이었다.

decisions.choice: Herod the tetrarch: Herod Antipas, ruler of Galilee
decisions.reason: Luke uses the title tetrarch for Herod Antipas, who ruled Galilee in Jesus's day (Luke 3:1, 3:19, 9:7). Agrippa, who died in 12:23, was a king.

decisions.choice: brought up with: raised together with, a childhood companion or foster brother
decisions.reason: The word means one reared alongside another. It was also used as an honorary title at royal courts, but here it most likely means Manaen grew up with Antipas.

decisions.choice: Niger: a Latin name meaning "black"
decisions.reason: It is a common Latin surname. Lucius comes from Cyrene in North Africa, from where some of the first preachers to Gentiles in Antioch had come (11:20).

decisions.choice: prophets and teachers: the five are named as one group
alternatives: the first three as prophets, the last two as teachers
decisions.reason: The way the Greek joins the names may hint at two groups, but Luke does not say who was which.

decisions.choice: Manaen had grown up with Herod, the ruler of Galilee
decisions.reason: Readable explains the title, as the meaning note does, and moves the fact about Manaen into its own sentence.

decisions.choice: tetrarca (L, B); el gobernante de Galilea (R)
decisions.reason: The book-wide wording for the tetrarch: Literal and Balanced keep the title, and Readable says what he ruled, as the English Readable does (meaning decision m1).

decisions.choice: narration in the passé simple (L, B) and the passé composé (R); historic presents kept at Literal
decisions.reason: As settled for the whole book in 1:1: the passé simple is the tense of written narrative for a careful public reading, and Readable uses the passé composé. Speeches keep their own tenses (see 13:17). This holds for the whole chapter.

decisions.choice: l’église (lowercase) for the church at Antioch
decisions.reason: One congregation is meant, so French writes "l’église", as the term sheet has it; "l’Église" is kept for the whole body of believers.

decisions.choice: Herode mtawala (L, B); Herode, mtawala wa Galilaya (R)
decisions.reason: The book-wide word for the tetrarch is "mtawala"; "mfalme" (king) would give Herod Antipas a title he did not have (meaning decision m1). Readable says what he ruled, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: Sauli (Paul)
decisions.reason: Saul is "Sauli" throughout Acts (7:58, 8, 9, 11, 13), the standard Swahili form of the name; the context tells Paul apart from King Saul in 13:21, as the Greek and English do with one name.

decisions.choice: "Si-mê-ôn", "Ni-giê", "Lu-si-út", "Ma-na-hem"; "tiểu vương Hê-rốt" (L, B), "người cai trị miền Ga-li-lê" (R)
decisions.reason: The Protestant forms of the names; Herod Antipas (meaning decision) is named as the Vietnamese Luke 3:1 and 9:7 name him.

decisions.choice: "giáo sư" for teachers in the church
decisions.reason: The word the Vietnamese church uses for those who teach in a congregation; "thầy" is kept for Jesus as Teacher.

decisions.choice: "교사들"; "시므온", "니게르", "루기오", "마나엔"; "분봉왕 헤롯" (L, B), "갈릴리를 다스리던 헤롯" (R)
decisions.reason: The Protestant forms of the names (style guide, Settled). Herod the tetrarch is Herod Antipas, ruler of Galilee (meaning decision), worded as in the Korean Matthew 14:1. "교사" is the word of the Korean letters for the teachers of a church.

source.text: λειτουργούντων δὲ αὐτῶν τῷ κυρίῳ καὶ νηστευόντων εἶπεν τὸ πνεῦμα τὸ ἅγιον· Ἀφορίσατε δή μοι τὸν Βαρναβᾶν καὶ Σαῦλον εἰς τὸ ἔργον ὃ προσκέκλημαι αὐτούς.

records.literal_gloss: As were ministering now they to the Lord and fasting, said the Spirit the Holy, Set apart then to me the Barnabas and Saul for the work to which I have called them.

en.L: Now as they were ministering to the Lord and fasting, the Holy Spirit said, "Set apart now for {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} Barnabas and Saul for the work to which I have called them."
en.B: While they were serving the Lord in worship and fasting, the Holy Spirit said, "Set Barnabas and Saul apart for {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, for the work I have called them to do."
en.R: One day they were worshiping the Lord and fasting. Then the Holy Spirit spoke to them: "Set Barnabas and Saul apart for {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}. I have called them to do a special work."

es.L: Mientras ellos servían al Señor y ayunaban, dijo el Espíritu Santo: «{{plural_you:Separen|Separad}} ahora para {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} a Bernabé y a Saulo para la obra a la que los he llamado».
es.B: Mientras servían al Señor en el culto y ayunaban, el Espíritu Santo dijo: «{{plural_you:Separen|Separad}} para {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} a Bernabé y a Saulo, para la obra a la que los he llamado».
es.R: Un día estaban adorando al Señor y ayunando. Entonces el Espíritu Santo les habló: «{{plural_you:Separen|Separad}} a Bernabé y a Saulo para {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}. Los he llamado a hacer un trabajo especial».

fr.L: Or, comme ils rendaient un culte au Seigneur et jeûnaient, l’Esprit Saint dit : « Mettez donc à part pour {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} Barnabas et Saul pour l’œuvre à laquelle je les ai appelés. »
fr.B: Pendant qu’ils célébraient le culte du Seigneur et qu’ils jeûnaient, l’Esprit Saint dit : « Mettez à part pour {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} Barnabas et Saul, en vue de l’œuvre à laquelle je les ai appelés. »
fr.R: Un jour, ils adoraient le Seigneur et jeûnaient. Alors l’Esprit Saint leur a parlé : « Mettez à part pour {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} Barnabas et Saul. Je les ai appelés pour faire un travail particulier. »

sw.L: Basi walipokuwa wakimhudumia Bwana na kufunga, Roho Mtakatifu alisema, "Watengeni sasa kwa ajili {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} Barnaba na Sauli kwa kazi ambayo nimewaitia."
sw.B: Walipokuwa wakimwabudu Bwana na kufunga, Roho Mtakatifu alisema, "Watengeni Barnaba na Sauli kwa ajili {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}, kwa kazi niliyowaitia."
sw.R: Siku moja walikuwa wakimwabudu Bwana na kufunga. Ndipo Roho Mtakatifu akawaambia, "Watengeni Barnaba na Sauli kwa ajili {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}. Nimewaita wafanye kazi maalum."

vi.L: Trong khi họ đang thờ phượng Chúa và kiêng ăn, Đức Thánh Linh phán: "Hãy biệt riêng Ba-na-ba và Sau-lơ cho {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} để làm công việc {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã gọi họ làm."
vi.B: Trong khi họ đang thờ phượng Chúa và kiêng ăn, Đức Thánh Linh phán: "Hãy biệt riêng Ba-na-ba và Sau-lơ cho {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, để làm công việc {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã gọi họ làm."
vi.R: Một ngày kia, họ đang thờ phượng Chúa và kiêng ăn. Bấy giờ Đức Thánh Linh nói với họ: "Hãy biệt riêng Ba-na-ba và Sau-lơ cho {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}. Ta đã gọi họ làm một công việc đặc biệt."

ko.L: 그런데 그들이 주님께 예배하며 금식하고 있을 때, 성령께서 말씀하셨다. "이제 나를 위하여 바나바와 사울을 따로 세워라. 내가 그들을 불러서 맡긴 일을 하게 하려는 것이다."
ko.B: 그들이 주님을 섬겨 예배하며 금식하고 있을 때, 성령께서 말씀하셨다. "바나바와 사울을 따로 세워 나에게 바쳐라. 내가 그들을 불러 맡긴 일을 하게 하여라."
ko.R: 어느 날 그들이 주님께 예배하며 금식하고 있었다. 그때 성령께서 그들에게 말씀하셨다. "바나바와 사울을 따로 세워 나에게 바쳐라. 내가 그들을 불러서 특별한 일을 맡겼다."

decisions.choice: ministering: serving the Lord in worship and prayer
decisions.reason: The word was used of priests serving in the temple (Luke 1:23, Hebrews 10:11). Here it describes the church's worship.

decisions.choice: they: the prophets and teachers, and perhaps the whole church
decisions.reason: The pronoun most naturally points back to the five named in 13:1. Luke does not say whether the rest of the church was there.

decisions.choice: the Holy Spirit speaks as a person and claims the two for himself
decisions.reason: The Spirit says "for me" and "I have called them". Luke does not say how the Spirit spoke; it may have been through one of the prophets.

decisions.choice: a special work
decisions.reason: Readable adds "special" to show that a particular task is meant; Luke tells what it was in the chapters that follow.

decisions.choice: {{plural_you:Separen|Separad}}; {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}
decisions.reason: Every plural "you" in this chapter, pronoun or verb, is the plural_you setting: the ustedes form by default, the vosotros form as the alternative. The Spirit's "mí" takes the deity_pronoun span as the English "me" does; the Spirit's "yo", unmarked in English, has none.

decisions.choice: spans only on free pronouns and possessives ("kwa ajili Yangu")
alternatives: a span for every pronoun the English marks
decisions.reason: Swahili marks most pronouns inside the verb, and a prefix cannot take a capital, so in this chapter the deity_pronoun setting applies only to free pronouns and possessives, and Swahili has fewer spans than English.

decisions.choice: wakimhudumia (L); wakimwabudu (B, R)
decisions.reason: The verb is service offered to the Lord in worship and prayer (meaning decision m1). Literal keeps "serving"; Balanced and Readable say "worshiping", which is what the service was.

decisions.choice: The Holy Spirit says "Ta", with the setting span in mid-sentence; "phán" (L, B), "nói" (R)
decisions.reason: The Spirit speaks as a person and claims the two for himself (meaning decision), in the forms God uses; the verb as in 8:29. The English marks only "me", but in Vietnamese "Ta" for God takes the span wherever it falls mid-sentence.

decisions.choice: "thờ phượng" for "ministering" to the Lord
decisions.reason: Serving the Lord in worship and prayer (meaning decision).

decisions.choice: the Holy Spirit speaks in 해라체 and says "나" ("세워라", "내가 ... 불러"), with the honorific in the narrative
decisions.reason: The Spirit speaks as a person and claims the two for himself (meaning decision), as God speaks in the Korean style guide (section 7a) and as in 8:29 and 10:19-20.

source.text: τότε νηστεύσαντες καὶ προσευξάμενοι καὶ ἐπιθέντες τὰς χεῖρας αὐτοῖς ἀπέλυσαν.

records.literal_gloss: Then having fasted and having prayed and having laid the hands on them they sent [them] off.

en.L: Then, having fasted and prayed and laid [their] hands on them, they sent [them] off.
en.B: Then, after more fasting and prayer, they laid their hands on the two men and let them go.
en.R: So the church fasted and prayed again. They put their hands on Barnabas and Saul and sent them on their way.

es.L: Entonces, habiendo ayunado y orado, y habiéndoles impuesto las manos, [los] despidieron.
es.B: Entonces, después de ayunar y orar más, impusieron las manos a los dos y los dejaron ir.
es.R: Así que la iglesia volvió a ayunar y a orar. Pusieron las manos sobre Bernabé y Saulo y los enviaron.

fr.L: Alors, ayant jeûné et prié et leur ayant imposé les mains, ils [les] laissèrent partir.
fr.B: Alors, après avoir encore jeûné et prié, ils posèrent les mains sur les deux hommes et les laissèrent partir.
fr.R: Alors l’église a de nouveau jeûné et prié. Les croyants ont posé les mains sur Barnabas et Saul, et ils les ont fait partir.

sw.L: Ndipo, wakiisha kufunga na kuomba na kuweka mikono juu yao, wakawaacha waende.
sw.B: Kisha, baada ya kufunga zaidi na kuomba, waliwawekea wale watu wawili mikono, wakawaruhusu waende.
sw.R: Basi kanisa lilifunga na kuomba tena. Wakaweka mikono yao juu ya Barnaba na Sauli, wakawatuma waende zao.

vi.L: Bấy giờ sau khi kiêng ăn, cầu nguyện và đặt tay trên hai ông, họ tiễn hai ông lên đường.
vi.B: Vậy sau khi kiêng ăn và cầu nguyện thêm, họ đặt tay trên hai người và tiễn đi.
vi.R: Vì vậy Hội Thánh lại kiêng ăn và cầu nguyện. Họ đặt tay trên Ba-na-ba và Sau-lơ và tiễn hai ông lên đường.

ko.L: 그래서 그들은 금식하고 기도하고 그들에게 손을 얹은 뒤에 떠나보냈다.
ko.B: 그래서 그들은 다시 금식하며 기도한 뒤에, 두 사람에게 손을 얹고 떠나보냈다.
ko.R: 그래서 교회는 다시 금식하며 기도했다. 그리고 바나바와 사울에게 손을 얹고 그들을 떠나보냈다.

decisions.choice: laying on of hands: a sign of blessing and of handing over a task
alternatives: giving them a rank they did not have
decisions.reason: The same act marked the Seven for their work (6:6). Paul and Barnabas later report back to this church about the work it had committed them to (14:26).

decisions.choice: sent off: released them, let them go
decisions.reason: The verb means to release or dismiss. The next verse says it was the Holy Spirit who sent them.

decisions.choice: the church ... again
decisions.reason: Readable names the subject, since the sentence carries on from 13:2, and says the fasting continued.

source.text: Αὐτοὶ μὲν οὖν ἐκπεμφθέντες ὑπὸ τοῦ ἁγίου πνεύματος κατῆλθον εἰς Σελεύκειαν, ἐκεῖθέν τε ἀπέπλευσαν εἰς Κύπρον, καὶ γενόμενοι ἐν Σαλαμῖνι κατήγγελλον τὸν λόγον τοῦ θεοῦ ἐν ταῖς συναγωγαῖς τῶν Ἰουδαίων· εἶχον δὲ καὶ Ἰωάννην ὑπηρέτην.

records.literal_gloss: They indeed therefore having been sent forth by the Holy Spirit went down to Seleucia, from there then they sailed to Cyprus, \v 5 and having come into Salamis they were proclaiming the word of God in the synagogues of the Jews; they had now also John [as] a helper.

en.L: So they, having been sent out by the Holy Spirit, went down to Seleucia, and from there they sailed to Cyprus. \v 5 And having arrived in Salamis, they were proclaiming the word of God in the synagogues of the Jews; and they also had John [as their] helper.
en.B: So, sent out by the Holy Spirit, the two went down to Seleucia, and from there they sailed to Cyprus. \v 5 Arriving at Salamis, they began to proclaim the word of God in the synagogues of the Jews. They also had John with them as an assistant.
en.R: The Holy Spirit sent Barnabas and Saul out. They went down to the port of Seleucia, and from there they sailed to the island of Cyprus. \v 5 When they came to the town of Salamis, they told people the word of God in the Jewish synagogues. John Mark was with them to help them.

es.L: Ellos, pues, enviados por el Espíritu Santo, bajaron a Seleucia, y de allí navegaron a Chipre, \v 5 y llegados a Salamina, anunciaban la palabra de Dios en las sinagogas de los judíos; y tenían también a Juan [como] ayudante.
es.B: Así, enviados por el Espíritu Santo, los dos bajaron a Seleucia, y de allí navegaron a Chipre. \v 5 Al llegar a Salamina, comenzaron a anunciar la palabra de Dios en las sinagogas de los judíos. También llevaban a Juan como asistente.
es.R: El Espíritu Santo envió a Bernabé y a Saulo. Ellos bajaron al puerto de Seleucia, y de allí navegaron a la isla de Chipre. \v 5 Cuando llegaron a la ciudad de Salamina, anunciaron la palabra de Dios en las sinagogas de los judíos. Juan Marcos iba con ellos para ayudarlos.

fr.L: Eux donc, envoyés par l’Esprit Saint, descendirent à Séleucie, et de là ils firent voile vers Chypre. \v 5 Et, arrivés à Salamine, ils annonçaient la parole de Dieu dans les synagogues des Juifs ; et ils avaient aussi Jean [comme] aide.
fr.B: Ainsi envoyés par l’Esprit Saint, les deux hommes descendirent à Séleucie, et de là ils s’embarquèrent pour Chypre. \v 5 Arrivés à Salamine, ils se mirent à annoncer la parole de Dieu dans les synagogues des Juifs. Ils avaient aussi Jean avec eux comme assistant.
fr.R: L’Esprit Saint a envoyé Barnabas et Saul. Ils sont descendus au port de Séleucie, et de là ils ont pris le bateau pour l’île de Chypre. \v 5 Quand ils sont arrivés dans la ville de Salamine, ils ont annoncé la parole de Dieu dans les synagogues juives. Jean-Marc était avec eux pour les aider.

sw.L: Basi wao, wakiisha kutumwa na Roho Mtakatifu, walishuka mpaka Seleukia, na kutoka huko wakasafiri baharini mpaka Kipro, \v 5 na walipofika Salami walikuwa wakilitangaza neno la Mungu katika masinagogi ya Wayahudi; tena walikuwa na Yohana [kama] msaidizi.
sw.B: Basi, wakiwa wametumwa na Roho Mtakatifu, wale wawili walishuka mpaka Seleukia, na kutoka huko wakasafiri baharini mpaka Kipro. \v 5 Walipofika Salami, walianza kulitangaza neno la Mungu katika masinagogi ya Wayahudi. Yohana pia alikuwa pamoja nao kama msaidizi wao.
sw.R: Roho Mtakatifu aliwatuma Barnaba na Sauli. Walishuka mpaka bandari ya Seleukia, na kutoka huko wakasafiri kwa meli mpaka kisiwa cha Kipro. \v 5 Walipofika mji wa Salami, waliwaambia watu neno la Mungu katika masinagogi ya Wayahudi. Yohana Marko alikuwa pamoja nao kuwasaidia.

vi.L: Vậy hai ông, được Đức Thánh Linh sai đi, xuống Sê-lơ-xi, rồi từ đó đi thuyền đến Chíp-rơ. \v 5 Đến Sa-la-min, hai ông rao truyền lời Đức Chúa Trời trong các nhà hội của người Do Thái; hai ông cũng có Giăng làm người phụ tá.
vi.B: Được Đức Thánh Linh sai đi, hai ông xuống Sê-lơ-xi, và từ đó đi thuyền đến Chíp-rơ. \v 5 Đến Sa-la-min, hai ông bắt đầu rao truyền lời Đức Chúa Trời trong các nhà hội của người Do Thái. Hai ông cũng có Giăng đi theo làm phụ tá.
vi.R: Đức Thánh Linh sai Ba-na-ba và Sau-lơ ra đi. Hai ông xuống hải cảng Sê-lơ-xi, và từ đó đi thuyền đến đảo Chíp-rơ. \v 5 Khi đến thị trấn Sa-la-min, hai ông nói lời Đức Chúa Trời cho người ta trong các nhà hội của người Do Thái. Giăng Mác cũng đi với hai ông để giúp đỡ.

ko.L: 그래서 그들은 성령께서 보내셔서 실루기아로 내려갔고, 거기서 배를 타고 구브로로 갔다. \v 5 그리고 살라미에 이르러 유대인들의 여러 회당에서 하나님의 말씀을 전했다. 그들에게는 요한도 조수로 있었다.
ko.B: 두 사람은 성령께서 보내시는 대로 실루기아로 내려가서, 거기서 배를 타고 구브로로 갔다. \v 5 그들은 살라미에 이르러 유대인들의 여러 회당에서 하나님의 말씀을 전하기 시작했다. 요한도 그들과 함께 있으면서 그들을 도왔다.
ko.R: 성령께서 바나바와 사울을 보내셨다. 그들은 실루기아라는 항구로 내려갔다. 거기서 배를 타고 구브로 섬으로 갔다. \v 5 그들은 살라미라는 마을에 도착해서, 유대인들의 회당에서 하나님의 말씀을 전했다. 요한 마가도 그들과 함께 가서 그들을 도왔다.

decisions.choice: Seleucia, Cyprus, Salamis: the port of Antioch, the island, and its chief eastern town
decisions.reason: Seleucia was the seaport of Syrian Antioch. Barnabas came from Cyprus (4:36), and believers from Cyprus had preached in Antioch (11:20). Salamis lay on the island's east coast.

decisions.choice: they were proclaiming: they set about preaching, from synagogue to synagogue
decisions.reason: The imperfect tense pictures an ongoing activity. Going first to the synagogue becomes Paul's pattern (13:14, 14:1, 17:1-2).

decisions.choice: John: John Mark, as their assistant
decisions.reason: John called Mark came with Barnabas and Saul from Jerusalem (12:12, 12:25). The word for helper means an assistant or attendant.

decisions.choice: the port of, the island of, the town of; John Mark
decisions.reason: Readable says what each place was and gives John his other name, as the meaning notes explain.

decisions.choice: sinagogas
decisions.reason: The book-wide word for the Jewish meeting places, as in the Gospels.

decisions.choice: Jean-Marc (R)
decisions.reason: French joins the two names with a hyphen, as it usually writes this man's name; Literal and Balanced keep "Jean" as the Greek has it.

decisions.choice: masinagogi
decisions.reason: The book-wide word for the Jewish meeting places, as in the Gospels.

decisions.choice: "Sê-lơ-xi", "Sa-la-min"
decisions.reason: The Protestant forms of the names.

decisions.choice: "실루기아", "구브로", "살라미"; "요한" (L, B), "요한 마가" (R); "조수" (L)
decisions.reason: The Protestant forms of the names (style guide, Settled). John is John Mark (meaning decision), whom Readable names in full, as the English Readable does.

source.text: διελθόντες δὲ ὅλην τὴν νῆσον ἄχρι Πάφου εὗρον ἄνδρα τινὰ μάγον ψευδοπροφήτην Ἰουδαῖον ᾧ ὄνομα Βαριησοῦ, ὃς ἦν σὺν τῷ ἀνθυπάτῳ Σεργίῳ Παύλῳ, ἀνδρὶ συνετῷ.

records.literal_gloss: Having passed through now all the island as far as Paphos they found a man certain, a magician, a false prophet, Jewish, whose name [was] Bar-Jesus, \v 7 who was with the proconsul Sergius Paulus, a man intelligent.

en.L: And having gone through the whole island as far as Paphos, they found a certain man, a magician, a Jewish false prophet, whose name [was] Bar-Jesus, \v 7 who was with the proconsul Sergius Paulus, an intelligent man.
en.B: They went across the whole island as far as Paphos, and there they came upon a Jewish magician, a false prophet, whose name was Bar-Jesus. \v 7 He was in the company of the proconsul Sergius Paulus, a man of understanding.
en.R: They traveled across the whole island to the city of Paphos. There they met a Jewish man named Bar-Jesus. He practiced magic and claimed to be a prophet, but he was a false prophet. \v 7 He was one of the people around Sergius Paulus, the Roman governor of the island. Sergius Paulus was a wise man.

es.L: Y habiendo atravesado toda la isla hasta Pafos, encontraron a cierto hombre, un mago, falso profeta judío, cuyo nombre [era] Barjesús, \v 7 que estaba con el procónsul Sergio Paulo, un hombre inteligente.
es.B: Recorrieron toda la isla hasta Pafos, y allí se encontraron con un mago judío, un falso profeta, que se llamaba Barjesús. \v 7 Este formaba parte del círculo del procónsul Sergio Paulo, un hombre de entendimiento.
es.R: Viajaron por toda la isla hasta la ciudad de Pafos. Allí conocieron a un judío llamado Barjesús. Practicaba la magia y decía ser profeta, pero era un falso profeta. \v 7 Estaba entre las personas cercanas a Sergio Paulo, el gobernador romano de la isla. Sergio Paulo era un hombre sabio.

fr.L: Et, ayant traversé toute l’île jusqu’à Paphos, ils trouvèrent un certain homme, un magicien, un faux prophète juif, dont le nom [était] Bar-Jésus, \v 7 qui était avec le proconsul Sergius Paulus, un homme intelligent.
fr.B: Ils parcoururent toute l’île jusqu’à Paphos, et là ils rencontrèrent un magicien juif, un faux prophète, nommé Bar-Jésus. \v 7 Il faisait partie de l’entourage du proconsul Sergius Paulus, un homme avisé.
fr.R: Ils ont traversé toute l’île jusqu’à la ville de Paphos. Là, ils ont rencontré un Juif qui s’appelait Bar-Jésus. Il faisait de la magie et il disait qu’il était prophète, mais c’était un faux prophète. \v 7 Il faisait partie des gens qui entouraient Sergius Paulus, le gouverneur romain de l’île. Sergius Paulus était un homme sage.

sw.L: Na wakiisha kupita katika kisiwa chote mpaka Pafo, walimkuta mtu mmoja, mchawi, nabii wa uongo, Myahudi, ambaye jina lake [lilikuwa] Bar-Yesu, \v 7 aliyekuwa pamoja na mkuu wa jimbo Sergio Paulo, mtu mwenye akili.
sw.B: Walipita katika kisiwa chote mpaka Pafo, na huko wakamkuta mchawi mmoja Myahudi, nabii wa uongo, jina lake Bar-Yesu. \v 7 Alikuwa miongoni mwa watu wa karibu wa mkuu wa jimbo, Sergio Paulo, mtu mwenye ufahamu.
sw.R: Walisafiri katika kisiwa chote mpaka mji wa Pafo. Huko walikutana na Myahudi mmoja jina lake Bar-Yesu. Alifanya uchawi na kudai kwamba ni nabii, lakini alikuwa nabii wa uongo. \v 7 Alikuwa mmoja wa watu waliokuwa karibu na Sergio Paulo, mtawala wa Kirumi wa kisiwa hicho. Sergio Paulo alikuwa mtu mwenye hekima.

vi.L: Đi khắp cả đảo đến tận Ba-phô, hai ông gặp một người Do Thái kia là thầy phù thủy và tiên tri giả, tên là Ba-Giê-xu, \v 7 người này ở với quan tổng trấn Sê-giút Phao-lút, là một người thông minh.
vi.B: Hai ông đi khắp đảo đến tận Ba-phô, và tại đó gặp một thầy phù thủy người Do Thái, một tiên tri giả, tên là Ba-Giê-xu. \v 7 Người này ở bên cạnh quan tổng trấn Sê-giút Phao-lút, là một người hiểu biết.
vi.R: Hai ông đi khắp đảo đến thành Ba-phô. Ở đó hai ông gặp một người Do Thái tên là Ba-Giê-xu. Người này làm phép thuật và tự xưng là nhà tiên tri, nhưng ông ta là tiên tri giả. \v 7 Ông ta là một trong những người ở bên cạnh Sê-giút Phao-lút, là quan tổng trấn La Mã cai trị đảo. Sê-giút Phao-lút là một người khôn ngoan.

ko.L: 그리고 그들은 온 섬을 거쳐 바보까지 가서, 바예수라는 유대인 마술사이자 거짓 예언자인 어떤 사람을 만났다. \v 7 그는 총독 서기오 바울과 함께 있었는데, 총독은 지혜로운 사람이었다.
ko.B: 그들은 섬을 두루 거쳐 바보에 이르렀다. 거기서 그들은 바예수라는 유대인 마술사를 만났는데, 그는 거짓 예언자였다. \v 7 그는 총독 서기오 바울 곁에 있었다. 총독은 슬기로운 사람이었다.
ko.R: 그들은 섬 전체를 지나서 바보라는 도시에 이르렀다. 거기서 그들은 바예수라는 유대 사람을 만났다. 그는 마술을 부리는 사람이었고, 자기가 예언자라고 했지만 거짓 예언자였다. \v 7 바예수는 서기오 바울 곁에 있는 사람들 가운데 하나였다. 서기오 바울은 그 섬을 다스리는 로마 총독이었고, 지혜로운 사람이었다.

decisions.choice: magician: one who claimed secret knowledge and powers
alternatives: a wise man from the East, as in Matthew 2:1
decisions.reason: The same word names the visitors in Matthew 2:1, but here, joined with "false prophet", it describes a man who practiced magic, like Simon in 8:9.

decisions.choice: Bar-Jesus: "son of Jesus", that is, son of Joshua
decisions.reason: Bar means son in Aramaic, and Jesus was a common Jewish name. Paul will call him "son of the devil" (13:10).

decisions.choice: proconsul: the Roman governor of a province ruled by the Senate
decisions.reason: Cyprus was a senatorial province, governed by a proconsul, in this period. Luke uses the correct title. Paphos, on the west coast, was the seat of government.

decisions.choice: who was with the proconsul: one of his circle, an adviser or attendant
decisions.reason: The phrase describes a lasting connection. Roman officials sometimes kept advisers who claimed to read the future.

decisions.choice: he practiced magic and claimed to be a prophet; the Roman governor of the island
alternatives: a magician, a false prophet; the proconsul
decisions.reason: Readable explains the two words and the title, as the meaning notes do.

decisions.choice: procónsul (L, B); el gobernador romano de la isla (R)
decisions.reason: Literal and Balanced keep the Roman title, which Spanish has; Readable explains it as the English Readable does (meaning decision m3). The same words for the proconsul through the chapter.

decisions.choice: mago
decisions.reason: "Mago" is one who claimed secret knowledge and powers (meaning decision m1), which is also how Luke explains the name Elymas in 13:8; "brujo" would suggest folk witchcraft.

decisions.choice: mkuu wa jimbo (L, B); mtawala wa Kirumi wa kisiwa hicho (R)
decisions.reason: The proconsul governed a province for the Roman Senate (meaning decision m3). "Mkuu wa mkoa" is kept for the governor of Judea (hegemon), and "liwali" and "gavana" were set aside in the Gospels, so "mkuu wa jimbo" keeps the two offices apart. A reviewer may prefer another title.

decisions.choice: mchawi; alifanya uchawi (R)
decisions.reason: One who claimed secret knowledge and powers (meaning decision m1). "Mganga" is a healer and would sound approving; "mchawi" is the common word for one who works magic, and Luke uses the same word to explain the name Elymas in 13:8.

decisions.choice: "thầy phù thủy" (L, B) for the magician; "Ba-Giê-xu"; "quan tổng trấn" (L, B, R) for the proconsul; "Sê-giút Phao-lút"
decisions.reason: One who claimed secret knowledge and powers (meaning decision); a proconsul was the Roman governor of a province ruled by the Senate, kept apart from "quan tổng đốc", the word for other governors. The name Bar-Jesus has "Giê-xu" without "Đức", since it is not Jesus.

decisions.choice: "Sê-giút Phao-lút", kept apart from "Phao-lô"
decisions.reason: The proconsul's name and the apostle's are the same Latin name in Greek; Vietnamese gives the proconsul the Latin form so the reader does not confuse the two men in 13:7-9.

decisions.choice: "바보", "바예수", "서기오 바울"; "총독" for anthypatos; "마술사", "거짓 예언자"
decisions.reason: The Protestant forms of the names. The proconsul was the Roman governor of a province (meaning decision); Korean "총독" says governor, and Readable adds that he was Roman, as the English Readable does.

source.text: οὗτος προσκαλεσάμενος Βαρναβᾶν καὶ Σαῦλον ἐπεζήτησεν ἀκοῦσαι τὸν λόγον τοῦ θεοῦ·

records.literal_gloss: This [man] having called to [him] Barnabas and Saul desired to hear the word of God;

en.L: This [man], having summoned Barnabas and Saul, sought to hear the word of God.
en.B: The proconsul sent for Barnabas and Saul and asked to hear the word of God.
en.R: Sergius Paulus asked Barnabas and Saul to come to him. He wanted to hear the word of God.

es.L: Este, habiendo llamado a Bernabé y a Saulo, procuraba oír la palabra de Dios.
es.B: El procónsul mandó llamar a Bernabé y a Saulo, y pidió oír la palabra de Dios.
es.R: Sergio Paulo pidió a Bernabé y a Saulo que fueran a verlo. Quería oír la palabra de Dios.

fr.L: Celui-ci, ayant fait appeler Barnabas et Saul, chercha à entendre la parole de Dieu.
fr.B: Le proconsul fit venir Barnabas et Saul et demanda à entendre la parole de Dieu.
fr.R: Sergius Paulus a demandé à Barnabas et à Saul de venir le voir. Il voulait entendre la parole de Dieu.

sw.L: Huyu, akiisha kuwaita Barnaba na Sauli, alitaka sana kusikia neno la Mungu.
sw.B: Mkuu huyo wa jimbo aliwaita Barnaba na Sauli, akaomba kusikia neno la Mungu.
sw.R: Sergio Paulo aliwaomba Barnaba na Sauli waje kwake. Alitaka kusikia neno la Mungu.

vi.L: Người này mời Ba-na-ba và Sau-lơ đến, muốn nghe lời Đức Chúa Trời.
vi.B: Quan tổng trấn cho mời Ba-na-ba và Sau-lơ đến, vì muốn nghe lời Đức Chúa Trời.
vi.R: Sê-giút Phao-lút mời Ba-na-ba và Sau-lơ đến gặp mình. Ông muốn nghe lời Đức Chúa Trời.

ko.L: 이 사람이 바나바와 사울을 불러 하나님의 말씀을 듣고자 했다.
ko.B: 총독은 바나바와 사울을 불러 하나님의 말씀을 듣기를 원했다.
ko.R: 서기오 바울은 바나바와 사울을 자기에게 오라고 했다. 그는 하나님의 말씀을 듣고 싶었다.

decisions.choice: this man: the proconsul, not the magician
decisions.reason: The last person named is Sergius Paulus, and the next verse sets the magician against him and his wish to hear.

decisions.choice: sought: wanted earnestly, asked
decisions.reason: The verb means to seek with intent or desire.

decisions.choice: the proconsul (B); Sergius Paulus (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name the man, as the meaning note explains.

source.text: ἀνθίστατο δὲ αὐτοῖς Ἐλύμας ὁ μάγος, οὕτως γὰρ μεθερμηνεύεται τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ, ζητῶν διαστρέψαι τὸν ἀνθύπατον ἀπὸ τῆς πίστεως.

records.literal_gloss: Was opposing however them Elymas the magician, thus for is translated the name of him, seeking to turn away the proconsul from the faith.

en.L: But Elymas the magician (for so his name is translated) was opposing them, seeking to turn the proconsul away from the faith.
en.B: But the magician Elymas, for that is how his name is translated, kept opposing them and tried to steer the proconsul away from the faith.
en.R: But the magician fought against them. (His name, Elymas, means "magician".) He tried to stop the governor from putting his faith in Jesus.

es.L: Pero se les oponía Elimas el mago (porque así se traduce su nombre), buscando apartar de la fe al procónsul.
es.B: Pero el mago Elimas, pues así se traduce su nombre, se les oponía una y otra vez y trataba de desviar de la fe al procónsul.
es.R: Pero el mago luchaba contra ellos. (Su nombre, Elimas, significa «mago»). Trataba de impedir que el gobernador pusiera su fe en Jesús.

fr.L: Mais Élymas le magicien (car c’est ainsi que se traduit son nom) s’opposait à eux, cherchant à détourner le proconsul de la foi.
fr.B: Mais le magicien Élymas, car c’est ce que veut dire son nom, ne cessait de leur faire obstacle et cherchait à détourner le proconsul de la foi.
fr.R: Mais le magicien s’est opposé à eux. (Son nom, Élymas, veut dire « magicien ».) Il essayait d’empêcher le gouverneur de mettre sa foi en Jésus.

sw.L: Lakini Elima yule mchawi (kwa maana ndivyo jina lake linavyotafsiriwa) alikuwa akiwapinga, akitafuta kumgeuza mkuu wa jimbo mbali na imani.
sw.B: Lakini yule mchawi Elima, kwa kuwa ndivyo jina lake linavyotafsiriwa, aliendelea kuwapinga, akijaribu kumgeuza mkuu wa jimbo mbali na imani.
sw.R: Lakini yule mchawi alipigana nao. (Jina lake, Elima, linamaanisha "mchawi".) Alijaribu kumzuia yule mtawala asimwamini Yesu.

vi.L: Nhưng Ê-ly-ma, thầy phù thủy (vì tên ông có nghĩa như vậy), chống đối hai ông, tìm cách làm cho quan tổng trấn xa rời đức tin.
vi.B: Nhưng thầy phù thủy Ê-ly-ma, vì tên ông được dịch ra như vậy, cứ chống đối hai ông và tìm cách làm cho quan tổng trấn xa rời đức tin.
vi.R: Nhưng thầy phù thủy ấy chống lại hai ông. (Tên ông ta là Ê-ly-ma, có nghĩa là "thầy phù thủy".) Ông ta tìm cách ngăn cản quan tổng trấn đặt đức tin nơi Đức Giê-xu.

ko.L: 그러나 마술사 엘루마는 (그의 이름이 그렇게 번역되기 때문이다) 그들을 대적하며 총독을 믿음에서 떠나게 하려고 했다.
ko.B: 그러나 마술사 엘루마는 (그 이름을 번역하면 마술사라는 뜻이다) 계속 그들을 방해하며 총독이 믿지 못하게 하려고 했다.
ko.R: 그러나 그 마술사가 그들을 가로막았다. (그의 이름 엘루마는 '마술사'라는 뜻이다.) 그는 총독이 예수를 믿지 못하게 하려고 했다.

decisions.choice: Elymas: another name, which Luke explains as meaning "magician"
decisions.reason: Elymas does not translate Bar-Jesus. Luke most likely means that Elymas is a word for magician or sorcerer, perhaps from a Semitic word for a wise man. The origin of the name is not certain.

decisions.choice: the faith: believing the message about Jesus
alternatives: the Christian teaching as a body of belief
decisions.reason: The proconsul was coming to believe (13:12). "The faith" here is that trust, which Elymas tried to prevent.

decisions.choice: was opposing: kept opposing them
decisions.reason: The imperfect tense pictures continued resistance.

decisions.choice: his name as an aside in parentheses; putting his faith in Jesus
decisions.reason: Readable sets the note about the name apart and says what the faith was, as the meaning notes explain.

decisions.choice: "엘루마"; the aside on the name in round brackets; "믿음" for pistis
decisions.reason: Elymas is another name, which Luke explains as meaning "magician" (meaning decision); Korean keeps Luke's aside where it stands and Balanced and Readable say what it means, as the English Readable does.

source.text: Σαῦλος δέ, ὁ καὶ Παῦλος, πλησθεὶς πνεύματος ἁγίου ἀτενίσας εἰς αὐτὸν εἶπεν· Ὦ πλήρης παντὸς δόλου καὶ πάσης ῥᾳδιουργίας, υἱὲ διαβόλου, ἐχθρὲ πάσης δικαιοσύνης, οὐ παύσῃ διαστρέφων τὰς ὁδοὺς κυρίου τὰς εὐθείας;

records.literal_gloss: Saul then, the [one] also [called] Paul, having been filled [with the] Holy Spirit, having looked intently upon him \v 10 said, O full of all deceit and all fraud, son of [the] devil, enemy of all righteousness, not will you cease perverting the ways of [the] Lord the straight?

en.L: But Saul, who [is] also [called] Paul, filled with [the] Holy Spirit, looked intently at him \v 10 [and] said, "O full of all deceit and all fraud, son of [the] devil, enemy of all righteousness, will you not stop perverting the straight ways of [the] Lord?
en.B: Then Saul, who is also called Paul, filled with the Holy Spirit, fixed his eyes on him \v 10 and said, "You are full of every kind of deceit and villainy, you son of the devil, you enemy of all righteousness! Will you never stop twisting the straight paths of the Lord?
en.R: Saul's other name was Paul. Now Paul was filled with the Holy Spirit. He looked straight at Elymas \v 10 and said, "You are full of lies and tricks! You are a son of the devil! You are an enemy of all righteousness! You keep trying to make the Lord's straight paths crooked. Will you never stop?

es.L: Pero Saulo, que también [se llama] Pablo, lleno del Espíritu Santo, fijando la mirada en él, \v 10 dijo: «¡Oh, lleno de todo engaño y de toda maldad, hijo del diablo, enemigo de toda justicia! ¿No dejarás de torcer los caminos rectos del Señor?
es.B: Entonces Saulo, que también se llama Pablo, lleno del Espíritu Santo, lo miró fijamente \v 10 y le dijo: «¡Estás lleno de toda clase de engaño y de maldad, hijo del diablo, enemigo de toda justicia! ¿Nunca dejarás de torcer los caminos rectos del Señor?
es.R: El otro nombre de Saulo era Pablo. Pablo estaba lleno del Espíritu Santo. Miró fijamente a Elimas \v 10 y le dijo: «¡Estás lleno de mentiras y de trampas! ¡Eres un hijo del diablo! ¡Eres enemigo de toda justicia! Siempre tratas de torcer los caminos rectos del Señor. ¿Nunca vas a parar?

fr.L: Mais Saul, qui [est] aussi [appelé] Paul, rempli de l’Esprit Saint, fixa les yeux sur lui \v 10 [et] dit : « Ô [toi qui es] plein de toute ruse et de toute fourberie, fils du diable, ennemi de toute justice, ne cesseras-tu pas de pervertir les voies droites du Seigneur ?
fr.B: Alors Saul, qu’on appelle aussi Paul, rempli de l’Esprit Saint, fixa les yeux sur lui \v 10 et dit : « Toi qui es plein de toute sorte de ruse et de malhonnêteté, fils du diable, ennemi de toute justice, ne cesseras-tu jamais de fausser les chemins droits du Seigneur ?
fr.R: Saul avait un autre nom : Paul. Paul était rempli de l’Esprit Saint. Il a regardé Élymas droit dans les yeux \v 10 et il lui a dit : « Tu es plein de mensonges et de ruses ! Tu es un fils du diable ! Tu es un ennemi de tout ce qui est juste ! Tu essaies toujours de rendre tordus les chemins droits du Seigneur. Est-ce que tu ne vas jamais arrêter ?

sw.L: Lakini Sauli, ambaye [ni] pia Paulo, akiwa amejaa Roho Mtakatifu, alimkazia macho \v 10 [na] kusema, "Ewe uliyejaa kila hila na kila uovu, mwana wa Ibilisi, adui wa haki yote, hutaacha kuzipotosha njia za Bwana zilizonyooka?
sw.B: Ndipo Sauli, ambaye pia anaitwa Paulo, akiwa amejaa Roho Mtakatifu, alimkazia macho \v 10 akasema, "Wewe umejaa kila aina ya udanganyifu na uovu, wewe mwana wa Ibilisi, wewe adui wa haki yote! Je, hutaacha kamwe kuzipotosha njia zilizonyooka za Bwana?
sw.R: Sauli alikuwa na jina lingine, Paulo. Basi Paulo alijazwa Roho Mtakatifu. Alimtazama Elima moja kwa moja \v 10 akasema, "Umejaa uongo na hila! Wewe ni mwana wa Ibilisi! Wewe ni adui wa haki yote! Siku zote unajaribu kuzifanya njia zilizonyooka za Bwana ziwe za kupinda. Je, hutaacha kamwe?

vi.L: Nhưng Sau-lơ, cũng gọi là Phao-lô, được đầy dẫy Đức Thánh Linh, nhìn thẳng vào ông ta \v 10 mà nói: "Hỡi kẻ đầy mọi điều gian dối và mọi mưu mô, con của ma quỷ, kẻ thù của mọi sự công chính, ngươi không ngừng làm cong vẹo đường ngay thẳng của Chúa sao?
vi.B: Bấy giờ Sau-lơ, cũng gọi là Phao-lô, được đầy dẫy Đức Thánh Linh, nhìn thẳng vào ông ta \v 10 và nói: "Ngươi đầy dẫy mọi thứ gian dối và xảo trá, hỡi con của ma quỷ, kẻ thù của mọi sự công chính! Ngươi không bao giờ thôi bẻ cong những đường ngay thẳng của Chúa sao?
vi.R: Sau-lơ còn có tên khác là Phao-lô. Bấy giờ Phao-lô được đầy dẫy Đức Thánh Linh. Ông nhìn thẳng vào Ê-ly-ma \v 10 và nói: "Ngươi đầy những lời dối trá và mánh khóe! Ngươi là con của ma quỷ! Ngươi là kẻ thù của mọi điều công chính! Ngươi cứ tìm cách làm cong vẹo những con đường ngay thẳng của Chúa. Ngươi không bao giờ thôi sao?

ko.L: 그러나 바울이라고도 하는 사울은 성령으로 충만하여 그를 똑바로 쳐다보며 \v 10 말했다. "오, 온갖 속임수와 악행으로 가득 찬 사람아, 마귀의 자식아, 모든 의의 원수야, 너는 주님의 곧은 길을 굽게 하는 짓을 그치지 않겠느냐?
ko.B: 그러자 바울이라고도 하는 사울이 성령으로 충만하여 그를 뚫어지게 바라보며 \v 10 말했다. "온갖 거짓과 악행으로 가득한 너, 마귀의 자식아, 모든 의의 원수야! 너는 주님의 곧은 길을 굽게 하는 짓을 언제까지 그치지 않겠느냐?
ko.R: 사울의 다른 이름은 바울이었다. 그때 바울은 성령으로 가득 차 있었다. 그는 엘루마를 똑바로 쳐다보며 \v 10 말했다. "너는 거짓말과 속임수로 가득 차 있다! 너는 마귀의 자식이다! 너는 모든 옳은 것의 원수다! 너는 주님의 곧은 길을 자꾸 굽게 만들려고 한다. 그런 짓을 그만두지 않겠느냐?

decisions.choice: Saul, who is also Paul: one man with two names
decisions.reason: Many Jews of the time had a Jewish name and a Greek or Roman one. Paul is a Roman name. From here on Luke calls him Paul, as he begins to work among Gentiles; Luke does not say he took the name at this moment.

decisions.choice: son of the devil: one who acts like the devil and serves him
decisions.reason: "Son of" means one who shares another's character (John 8:44). It answers his name Bar-Jesus, "son of Jesus" (13:6).

decisions.choice: righteousness: what is right in God's sight
decisions.reason: He opposes everything that is right and good before God.

decisions.choice: the straight ways of the Lord: the right paths God has made
decisions.reason: The prophets speak of the Lord's ways as straight and right (Hosea 14:9). Elymas twists them, by turning the proconsul from the truth. The Hebrew of such passages has the divine name.

decisions.choice: You keep trying to make the Lord's straight paths crooked. Will you never stop?
decisions.reason: Readable splits the question to make the picture clear.

decisions.choice: le diable; la justice (L, B), tout ce qui est juste (R)
decisions.reason: The term sheet's words: "le diable" in lowercase, and "la justice" for righteousness at Literal and Balanced. Readable says "tout ce qui est juste", which keeps the same root in plainer words.

decisions.choice: "Phao-lô" from here on for Paul
decisions.reason: One man with two names (meaning decision); the name of the Vietnamese letters (Romans 1:1). The narrator now calls him "ông", "Phao-lô" (for the whole book).

decisions.choice: Paul speaks to Elymas as "ngươi"
decisions.reason: A curse spoken in the power of the Spirit against an enemy of God's ways; "ngươi" is the Vietnamese of stern judgment from above, as in the Vietnamese Luke 12:20.

decisions.choice: "바울이라고도 하는 사울" at every level, and "바울" from here on in the narrative
decisions.reason: One man with two names (meaning decision); "바울" is the form of the Korean letters (Romans 1:1). From this verse Luke calls him Paul, and so does the Korean.

decisions.choice: Paul speaks to Elymas in 해라체 ("자식아", "-겠느냐?")
decisions.reason: A curse and rebuke, filled with the Spirit, as Peter speaks to Simon in 8:20-23; "자식" for huios here, as in a curse, where the son of the devil is one who acts like the devil and serves him (meaning decision).

source.text: καὶ νῦν ἰδοὺ χεὶρ κυρίου ἐπὶ σέ, καὶ ἔσῃ τυφλὸς μὴ βλέπων τὸν ἥλιον ἄχρι καιροῦ.

records.literal_gloss: And now behold, [the] hand of [the] Lord [is] upon you, and you will be blind, not seeing the sun for a season.

en.L: And now look, [the] hand of [the] Lord [is] upon you, and you will be blind, not seeing the sun for a time."
en.B: Now look: the hand of the Lord is against you. You will be blind and unable to see the sun for a while."
en.R: Now the Lord is going to punish you. You will be blind. For a while you will not even be able to see the sun."

es.L: Y ahora, mira, [la] mano del Señor [está] sobre ti, y quedarás ciego, sin ver el sol por un tiempo».
es.B: Ahora mira: la mano del Señor está contra ti. Quedarás ciego y no podrás ver el sol por un tiempo».
es.R: Ahora el Señor te va a castigar. Quedarás ciego. Por un tiempo ni siquiera podrás ver el sol».

fr.L: Et maintenant, voici la main du Seigneur sur toi, et tu seras aveugle, ne voyant pas le soleil pour un temps. »
fr.B: Maintenant, écoute : la main du Seigneur est contre toi. Tu seras aveugle et, pendant un certain temps, tu ne verras plus le soleil. »
fr.R: Maintenant, le Seigneur va te punir. Tu vas devenir aveugle. Pendant quelque temps, tu ne pourras même pas voir le soleil. »

sw.L: Na sasa, tazama, mkono wa Bwana [uko] juu yako, nawe utakuwa kipofu, usiyeona jua kwa muda."
sw.B: Sasa tazama, mkono wa Bwana uko dhidi yako. Utakuwa kipofu, na hutaweza kuliona jua kwa muda."
sw.R: Sasa Bwana atakuadhibu. Utakuwa kipofu. Kwa muda hutaweza hata kuliona jua."

vi.L: Và bây giờ, kìa, tay Chúa đang ở trên ngươi, ngươi sẽ bị mù, không thấy mặt trời trong một thời gian."
vi.B: Bây giờ, này, tay Chúa đang chống lại ngươi. Ngươi sẽ bị mù và không thấy mặt trời trong một thời gian."
vi.R: Bây giờ Chúa sắp phạt ngươi. Ngươi sẽ bị mù. Trong một thời gian, ngươi sẽ không thấy được cả mặt trời."

ko.L: 이제 보아라, 주님의 손이 너를 치신다. 너는 눈이 멀어서 얼마 동안 해를 보지 못할 것이다."
ko.B: 이제 보아라, 주님의 손이 너를 내리치신다. 너는 눈이 멀어 한동안 해를 보지 못할 것이다."
ko.R: 이제 주님께서 너에게 벌을 내리실 것이다. 너는 눈이 멀 것이다. 얼마 동안은 해도 보지 못할 것이다."

decisions.choice: the hand of the Lord upon you: the Lord acting against you in judgment
decisions.reason: The hand of the Lord can bring help (11:21) or punishment (1 Samuel 5:6, Exodus 9:3). Here it brings blindness.

decisions.choice: for a time: the blindness will not last for ever
decisions.reason: The phrase means until a set time. The judgment leaves room for mercy, as Saul's own blindness did (9:8-9, 9:18).

decisions.choice: the Lord is going to punish you
alternatives: the hand of the Lord is upon you
decisions.reason: Readable says what the picture means, as the meaning note explains.

source.text: παραχρῆμα δὲ ἔπεσεν ἐπ’ αὐτὸν ἀχλὺς καὶ σκότος, καὶ περιάγων ἐζήτει χειραγωγούς.

records.literal_gloss: Immediately then fell upon him mist and darkness, and going about he was seeking people to lead [him] by the hand.

en.L: And immediately mist and darkness fell upon him, and going about he was seeking people to lead [him] by the hand.
en.B: At once a mist and a darkness came down on him, and he moved about looking for someone to lead him by the hand.
en.R: Right away his eyes became misty and dark. He walked around trying to find someone to hold his hand and lead him.

es.L: Y al instante cayó sobre él niebla y oscuridad, y dando vueltas buscaba quien [lo] llevara de la mano.
es.B: Al instante cayeron sobre él una niebla y una oscuridad, y andaba de un lado a otro buscando a alguien que lo llevara de la mano.
es.R: Enseguida sus ojos se nublaron y todo se puso oscuro. Andaba de un lado a otro tratando de encontrar a alguien que lo tomara de la mano y lo guiara.

fr.L: Et aussitôt tombèrent sur lui un brouillard et des ténèbres, et, tournant çà et là, il cherchait des gens pour [le] conduire par la main.
fr.B: À l’instant même, un voile sombre et des ténèbres s’abattirent sur lui, et il tournait en tous sens, cherchant quelqu’un pour le conduire par la main.
fr.R: Tout de suite, ses yeux se sont brouillés et tout est devenu noir pour lui. Il tournait en rond et il cherchait quelqu’un pour lui tenir la main et le guider.

sw.L: Mara moja ukungu na giza vilimwangukia, naye akizunguka-zunguka alikuwa akitafuta watu wa kumwongoza kwa mkono.
sw.B: Mara moja ukungu na giza vilimshukia, akawa akizunguka-zunguka akitafuta mtu wa kumshika mkono na kumwongoza.
sw.R: Papo hapo macho yake yaliingiwa na ukungu na giza. Alizunguka huku na huko akitafuta mtu wa kumshika mkono na kumwongoza.

vi.L: Lập tức sương mù và bóng tối phủ lên ông ta, và ông ta đi quanh tìm người dắt tay mình.
vi.B: Lập tức sương mù và bóng tối phủ xuống ông ta, và ông ta mò mẫm tìm người dắt tay mình.
vi.R: Ngay lập tức mắt ông ta mờ đi và tối lại. Ông ta đi quanh tìm người nắm tay dẫn đường cho mình.

ko.L: 그러자 곧 안개와 어둠이 그를 덮쳤다. 그는 더듬으며 자기 손을 잡아 이끌어 줄 사람을 찾았다.
ko.B: 그러자 곧 안개와 어둠이 그를 덮었다. 그는 이리저리 더듬으며 손을 잡아 이끌어 줄 사람을 찾았다.
ko.R: 그러자 곧바로 그의 눈이 흐려지고 캄캄해졌다. 그는 이리저리 다니며 자기 손을 잡고 이끌어 줄 사람을 찾았다.

decisions.choice: mist: a clouding of the eyes
decisions.reason: The word was used by Greek doctors for a clouding of the eye. With darkness, it describes his sight failing.

decisions.choice: he was seeking: he kept groping about for a guide
decisions.reason: The imperfect tense pictures him searching, as Saul himself had once been led by the hand (9:8).

decisions.choice: his eyes became misty and dark
alternatives: mist and darkness fell on him
decisions.reason: Readable says plainly that the darkness was in his eyes, as the meaning note explains.

source.text: τότε ἰδὼν ὁ ἀνθύπατος τὸ γεγονὸς ἐπίστευσεν ἐκπλησσόμενος ἐπὶ τῇ διδαχῇ τοῦ κυρίου.

records.literal_gloss: Then having seen the proconsul the [thing] having happened believed, being astonished at the teaching of the Lord.

en.L: Then the proconsul, having seen what had happened, believed, being astonished at the teaching of the Lord.
en.B: The proconsul, seeing what had taken place, believed. He was struck with amazement at the teaching about the Lord.
en.R: When the governor saw what had happened, he believed. The teaching about the Lord Jesus amazed him.

es.L: Entonces el procónsul, viendo lo sucedido, creyó, asombrado ante la enseñanza del Señor.
es.B: El procónsul, al ver lo que había ocurrido, creyó. Estaba maravillado por la enseñanza acerca del Señor.
es.R: Cuando el gobernador vio lo que había pasado, creyó. La enseñanza acerca del Señor Jesús lo dejó asombrado.

fr.L: Alors le proconsul, voyant ce qui était arrivé, crut, frappé d’étonnement par l’enseignement du Seigneur.
fr.B: Voyant ce qui s’était passé, le proconsul crut. Il était profondément impressionné par l’enseignement qui concernait le Seigneur.
fr.R: Quand le gouverneur a vu ce qui s’était passé, il a cru. L’enseignement sur le Seigneur Jésus l’a beaucoup étonné.

sw.L: Ndipo mkuu wa jimbo, alipoona yaliyotokea, aliamini, akishangazwa na mafundisho ya Bwana.
sw.B: Mkuu wa jimbo alipoona yaliyotukia, aliamini. Alistaajabishwa sana na mafundisho kuhusu Bwana.
sw.R: Yule mtawala alipoona yaliyotokea, aliamini. Mafundisho kuhusu Bwana Yesu yalimshangaza sana.

vi.L: Khi thấy việc đã xảy ra, quan tổng trấn tin, và kinh ngạc về sự dạy dỗ của Chúa.
vi.B: Thấy việc đã xảy ra, quan tổng trấn tin Chúa. Ông rất kinh ngạc về sự dạy dỗ về Chúa.
vi.R: Khi quan tổng trấn thấy việc đã xảy ra, ông tin Chúa. Sự dạy dỗ về Chúa Giê-xu làm ông rất kinh ngạc.

ko.L: 그때 총독은 일어난 일을 보고 믿었다. 그는 주님에 관한 가르침에 몹시 놀랐다.
ko.B: 총독은 일어난 일을 보고 믿었다. 그는 주님에 관한 가르침에 깊이 감탄했다.
ko.R: 총독은 일어난 일을 보고 믿었다. 그는 주 예수에 관한 가르침을 듣고 몹시 놀랐다.

decisions.choice: the teaching of the Lord: the teaching about the Lord
decisions.reason: The phrase can mean either. Paul and Barnabas were proclaiming the message about Jesus; the teaching, more than the miracle, is what astonished him.

decisions.choice: believed: he came to believe the message
decisions.reason: Luke uses the same verb for coming to faith throughout Acts (4:4, 13:48). He does not say whether the proconsul was baptized.

decisions.choice: the Lord Jesus
decisions.reason: Readable names the Lord, as 13:8 and 13:38-39 make clear.

source.text: Ἀναχθέντες δὲ ἀπὸ τῆς Πάφου οἱ περὶ Παῦλον ἦλθον εἰς Πέργην τῆς Παμφυλίας· Ἰωάννης δὲ ἀποχωρήσας ἀπ’ αὐτῶν ὑπέστρεψεν εἰς Ἱεροσόλυμα.

records.literal_gloss: Having sailed then from Paphos those around Paul came to Perga of Pamphylia; John however having departed from them returned to Jerusalem.

en.L: Then, having put out to sea from Paphos, those around Paul came to Perga in Pamphylia; but John, leaving them, returned to Jerusalem.
en.B: Paul and those with him put out to sea from Paphos and came to Perga in Pamphylia. But John left them there and went back to Jerusalem.
en.R: Paul and his friends left Paphos by ship. They came to the town of Perga in the region of Pamphylia. But John Mark left them there and went home to Jerusalem.

es.L: Y habiéndose hecho a la mar desde Pafos, los que [estaban] en torno a Pablo llegaron a Perge de Panfilia; pero Juan, apartándose de ellos, volvió a Jerusalén.
es.B: Pablo y sus compañeros se hicieron a la mar desde Pafos y llegaron a Perge, en Panfilia. Pero Juan se separó de ellos allí y regresó a Jerusalén.
es.R: Pablo y sus amigos salieron de Pafos en barco. Llegaron a la ciudad de Perge, en la región de Panfilia. Pero Juan Marcos los dejó allí y se volvió a su casa en Jerusalén.

fr.L: Puis, ayant pris la mer depuis Paphos, ceux qui entouraient Paul arrivèrent à Perge de Pamphylie ; mais Jean, les ayant quittés, retourna à Jérusalem.
fr.B: Paul et ses compagnons s’embarquèrent à Paphos et arrivèrent à Perge, en Pamphylie. Mais Jean les quitta et retourna à Jérusalem.
fr.R: Paul et ses amis ont quitté Paphos en bateau. Ils sont arrivés dans la ville de Perge, dans la région de la Pamphylie. Mais là, Jean-Marc les a quittés, et il est rentré chez lui, à Jérusalem.

sw.L: Basi wakiisha kuanza safari baharini kutoka Pafo, wale waliokuwa pamoja na Paulo walifika Perge ya Pamfilia; lakini Yohana, akiisha kujitenga nao, alirudi Yerusalemu.
sw.B: Paulo na wenzake walipanda meli kutoka Pafo, wakafika Perge katika Pamfilia. Lakini Yohana aliwaacha huko, akarudi Yerusalemu.
sw.R: Paulo na rafiki zake waliondoka Pafo kwa meli. Wakafika mji wa Perge katika eneo la Pamfilia. Lakini Yohana Marko aliwaacha huko, akarudi nyumbani Yerusalemu.

vi.L: Phao-lô và những người cùng đi với ông đi thuyền từ Ba-phô đến Bẹt-giê thuộc xứ Bam-phi-ly; nhưng Giăng rời bỏ họ mà trở về Giê-ru-sa-lem.
vi.B: Phao-lô và những người đi cùng ông đi thuyền từ Ba-phô đến Bẹt-giê thuộc xứ Bam-phi-ly. Nhưng Giăng rời bỏ họ ở đó và trở về Giê-ru-sa-lem.
vi.R: Phao-lô và các bạn đồng hành rời Ba-phô bằng thuyền. Họ đến thị trấn Bẹt-giê thuộc miền Bam-phi-ly. Nhưng Giăng Mác rời bỏ họ ở đó và trở về nhà ở Giê-ru-sa-lem.

ko.L: 그런데 바울 일행은 바보에서 배를 타고 밤빌리아의 버가로 갔다. 그러나 요한은 그들을 떠나 예루살렘으로 돌아갔다.
ko.B: 바울 일행은 바보에서 배를 타고 밤빌리아의 버가에 이르렀다. 그러나 요한은 거기서 그들과 헤어져 예루살렘으로 돌아갔다.
ko.R: 바울과 그의 동료들은 바보를 떠나 배를 타고 갔다. 그들은 밤빌리아 지방의 버가라는 마을에 도착했다. 그러나 요한 마가는 거기서 그들을 떠나 고향 예루살렘으로 돌아갔다.

decisions.choice: those around Paul: Paul and his companions
decisions.reason: From here Luke usually names Paul first (13:43, 13:46), as the leader in speaking.

decisions.choice: Perga of Pamphylia: a city near the south coast of Asia Minor
decisions.reason: Pamphylia was a region on the southern coast of what is now Turkey.

decisions.choice: departed: withdrew from them
decisions.reason: Luke does not give his reason. Paul later refused to take him again because he had left them (15:38).

decisions.choice: the town of, the region of; John Mark
decisions.reason: Readable says what the places were and names John as in 13:5.

decisions.choice: "Bẹt-giê", "Bam-phi-ly"
decisions.reason: The Protestant forms of the names; "Bam-phi-ly" as in 2:10.

decisions.choice: "바울 일행" (L, B), "바울과 그의 동료들" (R); "버가", "밤빌리아"
decisions.reason: Those around Paul are Paul and his companions (meaning decision); the Protestant forms of the names, as in 2:10.

source.text: αὐτοὶ δὲ διελθόντες ἀπὸ τῆς Πέργης παρεγένοντο εἰς Ἀντιόχειαν τὴν Πισιδίαν, καὶ εἰσελθόντες εἰς τὴν συναγωγὴν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῶν σαββάτων ἐκάθισαν.

records.literal_gloss: They now having passed through from Perga came to Antioch the Pisidian, and having gone into the synagogue on the day of the Sabbaths they sat down.

en.L: And they, having gone on from Perga, came to Pisidian Antioch, and going into the synagogue on the day of the Sabbath, they sat down.
en.B: They went on from Perga and arrived at Antioch near Pisidia. On the Sabbath day they went into the synagogue and took their seats.
en.R: From Perga they traveled inland to the city of Antioch, near the region of Pisidia. On the Sabbath day they went into the synagogue and sat down.

es.L: Y ellos, pasando desde Perge, llegaron a Antioquía de Pisidia, y entrando en la sinagoga el día de los sábados, se sentaron.
es.B: Ellos siguieron desde Perge y llegaron a Antioquía, cerca de Pisidia. El sábado entraron en la sinagoga y se sentaron.
es.R: Desde Perge viajaron tierra adentro hasta la ciudad de Antioquía, cerca de la región de Pisidia. El sábado entraron en la sinagoga y se sentaron.

fr.L: Et eux, ayant poursuivi depuis Perge, arrivèrent à Antioche de Pisidie, et, entrés dans la synagogue le jour du sabbat, ils s’assirent.
fr.B: Ils poursuivirent leur route depuis Perge et arrivèrent à Antioche, près de la Pisidie. Le jour du sabbat, ils entrèrent dans la synagogue et y prirent place.
fr.R: De Perge, ils sont allés vers l’intérieur du pays, jusqu’à la ville d’Antioche, près de la région de la Pisidie. Le jour du sabbat, ils sont entrés dans la synagogue et ils se sont assis.

sw.L: Nao, wakiisha kupita kutoka Perge, walifika Antiokia ya Pisidia, na wakiisha kuingia katika sinagogi siku ya Sabato, waliketi.
sw.B: Waliendelea kutoka Perge, wakafika Antiokia karibu na Pisidia. Siku ya Sabato waliingia katika sinagogi, wakaketi.
sw.R: Kutoka Perge walisafiri kuelekea bara mpaka mji wa Antiokia, karibu na eneo la Pisidia. Siku ya Sabato waliingia katika sinagogi, wakaketi.

vi.L: Còn họ thì từ Bẹt-giê tiếp tục đi đến An-ti-ốt xứ Bi-si-đi, và vào ngày Sa-bát, họ vào nhà hội và ngồi xuống.
vi.B: Họ đi tiếp từ Bẹt-giê đến An-ti-ốt gần xứ Bi-si-đi. Vào ngày Sa-bát, họ đến nhà hội và ngồi xuống.
vi.R: Từ Bẹt-giê, họ đi vào đất liền đến thành An-ti-ốt, gần miền Bi-si-đi. Vào ngày Sa-bát, họ đến nhà hội và ngồi xuống.

ko.L: 그리고 그들은 버가를 떠나 비시디아 안디옥에 이르렀다. 그리고 안식일에 회당에 들어가 앉았다.
ko.B: 그들은 버가에서 더 나아가 비시디아 지방에 가까운 안디옥에 이르렀다. 그리고 안식일에 회당에 들어가 자리에 앉았다.
ko.R: 그들은 버가에서 내륙으로 들어가 비시디아 지방 가까이에 있는 안디옥이라는 도시로 갔다. 안식일에 그들은 회당에 들어가서 앉았다.

decisions.choice: Pisidian Antioch: the Antioch toward Pisidia, a Roman colony inland
decisions.reason: This is not the Antioch of 13:1. This city lay in the province of Galatia, in Phrygia, near the border of Pisidia, which is why it was called Pisidian Antioch.

decisions.choice: they sat down: they joined the synagogue meeting
decisions.reason: Visitors sat among the congregation. In 13:15 the leaders invite them to speak.

decisions.choice: Antioch near Pisidia
decisions.reason: The city was close to Pisidia rather than in it, as the meaning note explains; Literal keeps the Greek description.

decisions.choice: el sábado; Literal keeps the Greek plural, "el día de los sábados"
decisions.reason: The book-wide word for the Sabbath; the Greek plural means a single Sabbath day.

decisions.choice: la synagogue; le sabbat (lowercase)
decisions.reason: The term sheet's forms for the whole New Testament; "sabbat" is a common noun in French and takes no capital.

decisions.choice: siku ya Sabato
decisions.reason: The book-wide word for the Sabbath at every level; the Greek plural "day of the Sabbaths" means one Sabbath day, so Swahili uses the singular even at Literal.

decisions.choice: "An-ti-ốt xứ Bi-si-đi" (L); "An-ti-ốt gần xứ Bi-si-đi" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The Antioch toward Pisidia (meaning decision), kept apart from Antioch in Syria.

decisions.choice: "비시디아 안디옥" (L); "비시디아 지방에 가까운 안디옥" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The Antioch toward Pisidia, a Roman colony inland (meaning decision), kept apart from the Antioch of Syria (11:19); the Protestant form "비시디아".

source.text: μετὰ δὲ τὴν ἀνάγνωσιν τοῦ νόμου καὶ τῶν προφητῶν ἀπέστειλαν οἱ ἀρχισυνάγωγοι πρὸς αὐτοὺς λέγοντες· Ἄνδρες ἀδελφοί, εἴ τίς ἐστιν ἐν ὑμῖν λόγος παρακλήσεως πρὸς τὸν λαόν, λέγετε.

records.literal_gloss: After then the reading of the law and of the prophets sent the synagogue rulers to them saying, Men brothers, if any is among you word of exhortation toward the people, speak.

en.L: And after the reading of the Law and the Prophets, the rulers of the synagogue sent to them, saying, "Men, brothers, if there is among you any word of exhortation for the people, speak."
en.B: When the Law and the Prophets had been read, the leaders of the synagogue sent a message to them: "Brothers, if one of you has a word of encouragement for the people, speak."
en.R: First, some parts of God's law and of the books of the prophets were read aloud. Then the leaders of the synagogue sent someone to say to Paul and Barnabas, "Brothers, if you have anything to say that will encourage the people, please tell us."

es.L: Y después de la lectura de la Ley y de los Profetas, los jefes de la sinagoga mandaron a decirles: «Hombres, hermanos, si hay entre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} alguna palabra de exhortación para el pueblo, {{plural_you:hablen|hablad}}».
es.B: Después de la lectura de la Ley y de los Profetas, los jefes de la sinagoga les mandaron este mensaje: «Hermanos, si alguno de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} tiene una palabra de aliento para el pueblo, {{plural_you:hablen|hablad}}».
es.R: Primero se leyeron en voz alta algunas partes de la ley de Dios y de los libros de los profetas. Luego los jefes de la sinagoga mandaron a alguien a decir a Pablo y a Bernabé: «Hermanos, si {{plural_you:tienen|tenéis}} algo que decir para animar al pueblo, por favor, {{plural_you:dígannoslo|decídnoslo}}».

fr.L: Et, après la lecture de la Loi et des Prophètes, les chefs de la synagogue leur envoyèrent dire : « Hommes, frères, s’il y a parmi vous une parole d’exhortation pour le peuple, parlez. »
fr.B: Après la lecture de la Loi et des Prophètes, les responsables de la synagogue leur firent dire : « Frères, si l’un de vous a une parole d’encouragement pour le peuple, qu’il parle. »
fr.R: D’abord, on a lu à haute voix des passages de la Loi de Dieu et des livres des prophètes. Ensuite, les responsables de la synagogue ont envoyé quelqu’un dire à Paul et à Barnabas : « Frères, si vous avez quelque chose à dire pour encourager le peuple, parlez, s’il vous plaît. »

sw.L: Na baada ya kusomwa kwa Sheria na Manabii, wakuu wa sinagogi waliwatumia [ujumbe] wakisema, "Ndugu, kama kuna kati yenu neno lolote la mawaidha kwa ajili ya watu, semeni."
sw.B: Baada ya kusomwa kwa Sheria na Manabii, viongozi wa sinagogi waliwatumia ujumbe: "Ndugu, ikiwa mmoja wenu ana neno la kuwatia moyo watu, semeni."
sw.R: Kwanza, sehemu za sheria ya Mungu na za vitabu vya manabii zilisomwa kwa sauti. Kisha viongozi wa sinagogi walimtuma mtu awaambie Paulo na Barnaba, "Ndugu, kama mna neno lolote la kuwatia watu moyo, tafadhali tuambieni."

vi.L: Sau khi đọc sách luật pháp và các sách tiên tri, các người lãnh đạo nhà hội sai người đến nói với họ: "Thưa các anh em, nếu anh em có lời khích lệ nào cho dân chúng, xin hãy nói."
vi.B: Sau khi luật pháp và các sách tiên tri đã được đọc, các người lãnh đạo nhà hội sai người đến nói với họ: "Thưa anh em, nếu ai trong anh em có lời khích lệ nào cho dân chúng, xin cứ nói."
vi.R: Trước hết, người ta đọc lớn một số đoạn trong luật pháp của Đức Chúa Trời và trong sách của các nhà tiên tri. Rồi các người lãnh đạo nhà hội sai người đến nói với Phao-lô và Ba-na-ba: "Thưa anh em, nếu anh em có điều gì khích lệ dân chúng, xin cứ nói cho chúng tôi nghe."

ko.L: 그런데 율법과 예언서를 읽은 뒤에, 회당장들이 그들에게 사람을 보내어 말했다. "형제 여러분, 백성을 위한 권면의 말씀이 여러분에게 있으면 말씀해 주십시오."
ko.B: 율법서와 예언서 낭독이 끝나자, 회당장들이 그들에게 사람을 보내어 말했다. "형제 여러분, 백성에게 격려가 될 말씀이 있으면 해 주십시오."
ko.R: 먼저 하나님의 율법과 예언자들의 책 몇 부분을 소리 내어 읽었다. 그런 다음 회당을 이끄는 지도자들이 바울과 바나바에게 사람을 보내어 말했다. "형제 여러분, 사람들에게 힘이 될 말이 있으면 우리에게 해 주십시오."

decisions.choice: the reading of the Law and the Prophets: the readings of a synagogue service
decisions.reason: A passage from the law of Moses was read, and then one from the Prophets (Luke 4:16-17). Visitors might then be asked to speak.

decisions.choice: rulers of the synagogue: the leaders in charge of the meeting
decisions.reason: They chose who would read and speak (Luke 8:41, 13:14).

decisions.choice: men, brothers: a courteous address to fellow Jews, here to Paul and his companions
decisions.reason: The rulers speak to the visiting men. As a group of named men is meant, the address does not include women here.

decisions.choice: word of exhortation: a message of encouragement and appeal
decisions.reason: The word covers both encouragement and urging. Hebrews calls itself a word of exhortation (Hebrews 13:22).

decisions.choice: Brothers, with no setting
decisions.reason: The rulers speak to the men who came with Paul, as the meaning note explains; Literal keeps "Men, brothers".

decisions.choice: some parts of God's law and of the books of the prophets were read aloud
alternatives: after the reading of the Law and the Prophets
decisions.reason: Readable explains what the reading was.

decisions.choice: Hombres, hermanos (L); Hermanos (B, R), no gender span
decisions.reason: The courteous address among Jews (meaning decision m3). Literal shows both Greek words; Balanced and Readable say "Hermanos", which in Spanish already includes sisters, so there is no gender span.

decisions.choice: la Loi et les Prophètes (capitalised)
decisions.reason: The Law of Moses is "la Loi" with a capital, as the term sheet has it; here, with "les Prophètes", it names the books read in the synagogue. Readable speaks of "les livres des prophètes", as the English does.

decisions.choice: Ndugu (at every level)
decisions.reason: The Greek pairs "men" with "brothers" as a courteous address among Jews (meaning decision m3). Swahili "ndugu" is that address by itself; "wanaume" would stress that they are male, which the Greek address does not, so Literal too says "Ndugu". The same in 13:26 and 13:38.

decisions.choice: wakuu wa sinagogi (L); viongozi wa sinagogi (B, R)
decisions.reason: The book-wide wording for the synagogue leaders, here in the plural.

decisions.choice: "Thưa các anh em" (L), "Thưa anh em" (B, R), with no gender span, and "anh em" for "you"
decisions.reason: A courteous address to fellow Jews, here to Paul and his companions (meaning decision), who are men; the English has no setting here.

decisions.choice: "các người lãnh đạo nhà hội" for the rulers of the synagogue
decisions.reason: The phrase of the Vietnamese Luke 8:41 and 13:14.

decisions.choice: "회당장들" (L, B), "회당을 이끄는 지도자들" (R), as the Korean Luke 13:14; "형제 여러분" with no gender span; the rulers speak to the visitors in 합쇼체
decisions.reason: Men, brothers here is a courteous address to fellow Jews, here to Paul and his companions (meaning decision), so there is no span, as in the English.

source.text: ἀναστὰς δὲ Παῦλος καὶ κατασείσας τῇ χειρὶ εἶπεν· Ἄνδρες Ἰσραηλῖται καὶ οἱ φοβούμενοι τὸν θεόν, ἀκούσατε.

records.literal_gloss: Having risen then Paul and having motioned with the hand said, Men Israelites and those fearing God, listen.

en.L: Then Paul stood up, and motioning with [his] hand said, "Men, Israelites, and those who fear God, listen.
en.B: Paul stood up, waved his hand for quiet, and said, "{{gender:People|Men}} of Israel, and you God-fearing Gentiles, listen.
en.R: So Paul stood up. He raised his hand to ask them to be quiet. Then he said, "People of Israel, and you other people here who worship God, listen to me!

es.L: Entonces Pablo, levantándose y haciendo señal con la mano, dijo: «Hombres israelitas, y los que temen a Dios, {{plural_you:escuchen|escuchad}}.
es.B: Pablo se puso de pie, pidió silencio con la mano y dijo: «Israelitas, y {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, gentiles que temen a Dios, {{plural_you:escuchen|escuchad}}.
es.R: Entonces Pablo se puso de pie. Levantó la mano para pedirles que guardaran silencio. Luego dijo: «Pueblo de Israel, y {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, los demás que están aquí y adoran a Dios, ¡{{plural_you:escúchenme|escuchadme}}!

fr.L: Alors Paul se leva et, faisant signe de la main, dit : « Hommes, Israélites, et vous qui craignez Dieu, écoutez.
fr.B: Paul se leva, fit signe de la main pour qu’on se taise et dit : « {{gender:Israélites|Hommes d’Israël}}, et vous, non-Juifs qui craignez Dieu, écoutez.
fr.R: Alors Paul s’est levé. Il a levé la main pour leur demander de se taire. Puis il a dit : « Peuple d’Israël, et vous aussi, les autres, qui adorez Dieu, écoutez-moi !

sw.L: Ndipo Paulo, akiisha kusimama na kuashiria kwa mkono, alisema, "Waisraeli, na ninyi mnaomcha Mungu, sikilizeni.
sw.B: Paulo alisimama, akawapungia mkono ili wanyamaze, akasema, "Enyi Waisraeli, na ninyi watu wa mataifa mnaomcha Mungu, sikilizeni.
sw.R: Basi Paulo alisimama. Aliinua mkono wake kuwaomba wanyamaze. Kisha akasema, "Enyi watu wa Israeli, na ninyi wengine mlio hapa mnaomwabudu Mungu, nisikilizeni!

vi.L: Phao-lô đứng dậy, giơ tay ra hiệu và nói: "Thưa các ông người Y-sơ-ra-ên và quý vị là những người kính sợ Đức Chúa Trời, xin hãy nghe.
vi.B: Phao-lô đứng dậy, giơ tay ra hiệu cho mọi người im lặng và nói: "Thưa {{gender:đồng bào Y-sơ-ra-ên|các ông người Y-sơ-ra-ên}}, và quý vị là những người ngoại kính sợ Đức Chúa Trời, xin hãy lắng nghe.
vi.R: Vậy Phao-lô đứng dậy. Ông giơ tay ra hiệu cho họ im lặng. Rồi ông nói: "Thưa đồng bào Y-sơ-ra-ên, và quý vị khác ở đây là những người kính sợ Đức Chúa Trời, xin hãy nghe tôi!

ko.L: 그러자 바울이 일어나서 손짓을 하며 말했다. "이스라엘 사람 여러분, 그리고 하나님을 경외하는 여러분, 들으십시오.
ko.B: 바울이 일어나 손짓으로 조용히 하게 한 뒤에 말했다. "이스라엘 사람 여러분, 그리고 하나님을 경외하는 이방 사람 여러분, 들어 주십시오.
ko.R: 그러자 바울이 일어섰다. 그는 손을 들어 사람들에게 조용히 해 달라고 했다. 그리고 말했다. "이스라엘 사람 여러분, 그리고 여기서 하나님을 섬기는 다른 민족 여러분, 내 말을 들어 주십시오!

decisions.choice: men, Israelites: a formal address to the Jews in the synagogue
decisions.reason: Speeches in Acts open this way (2:22, 3:12). Women were present in synagogue meetings, and women of the city are named in 13:50, so the address most likely takes in the whole congregation; the words alone cannot settle it.

decisions.choice: those who fear God: Gentiles who worshiped the God of Israel without becoming Jews
decisions.reason: Luke uses this phrase for Gentiles like Cornelius (10:2, 10:22). Here they are set beside the Israelites, and again in 13:26.

decisions.choice: motioning with his hand: a speaker's gesture for silence
decisions.reason: Peter and Paul do the same before speaking (12:17, 21:40).

decisions.choice: People of Israel, with "Men of Israel" as the alternative
decisions.reason: The inclusive default follows the meaning note; Literal keeps "men".

decisions.choice: you God-fearing Gentiles
decisions.reason: Balanced names the group, as the meaning note explains; Literal keeps the phrase.

decisions.choice: you other people here who worship God
decisions.reason: Readable says plainly that these hearers are not Israelites and that they worship God.

decisions.choice: Israelitas (B); Pueblo de Israel (R), no gender span
decisions.reason: Unlike the English "People of Israel / Men of Israel", Spanish "israelitas" and "pueblo de Israel" already include the women in the synagogue, so no gender span is needed; Literal keeps "Hombres israelitas" (meaning decision m1).

decisions.choice: {{gender:Israélites|Hommes d’Israël}} (B)
decisions.reason: English "People of Israel" becomes "Israélites", which is already inclusive in French as a form of address; the traditional "Hommes d’Israël" is the alternative, as the English has "Men of Israel". Readable says "Peuple d’Israël" with no setting, as the English does.

decisions.choice: non-Juifs (B, R) where the English says "Gentiles"; les nations (L)
decisions.reason: As the term sheet has it for the whole New Testament: "les païens" now sounds like unbelievers, while these people worship God; "non-Juifs" says plainly who they are. Literal keeps "les nations" for the Greek word (13:46, 13:48).

decisions.choice: Waisraeli (L, B); watu wa Israeli (R), no gender span
decisions.reason: Swahili "Waisraeli" and "watu wa Israeli" already include the women in the synagogue, so there is no gender span; "wanaume" would narrow the address to the men (meaning decision m1).

decisions.choice: The address as in Peter's speeches (2:22; 3:12), with "quý vị" for the God-fearing Gentiles; Paul says "anh em" for "you" to the whole synagogue (13:16-41)
decisions.reason: Paul speaks to his own people as Peter did; the Gentile worshippers are named with the courteous "quý vị", as Peter speaks to Cornelius's household (10:28).

decisions.choice: Paul speaks to the synagogue in 합쇼체 and says "나" and "우리" (13:16-41); "하나님을 경외하는 여러분" (L), "하나님을 경외하는 이방 사람 여러분" (B), "하나님을 섬기는 다른 민족 여러분" (R)
decisions.reason: As Peter's speeches (2:14; 3:12): a public address in the formal polite style, with "사람 여러분" already inclusive. The God-fearers are Gentiles who worshiped the God of Israel without becoming Jews (meaning decision), worded as at 10:2.

source.text: ὁ θεὸς τοῦ λαοῦ τούτου Ἰσραὴλ ἐξελέξατο τοὺς πατέρας ἡμῶν, καὶ τὸν λαὸν ὕψωσεν ἐν τῇ παροικίᾳ ἐν γῇ Αἰγύπτου, καὶ μετὰ βραχίονος ὑψηλοῦ ἐξήγαγεν αὐτοὺς ἐξ αὐτῆς, καί, ὡς τεσσερακονταετῆ χρόνον ἐτροποφόρησεν αὐτοὺς ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ, καὶ καθελὼν ἔθνη ἑπτὰ ἐν γῇ Χανάαν κατεκληρονόμησεν τὴν γῆν αὐτῶν ὡς ἔτεσι τετρακοσίοις καὶ πεντήκοντα.

records.literal_gloss: The God of the people this Israel chose the fathers of us, and the people exalted in the sojourn in [the] land of Egypt, and with arm uplifted brought them out of it, \v 18 and of about forty years [a] period he endured the ways of them in the wilderness, \v 19 and having destroyed nations seven in [the] land of Canaan he gave as inheritance the land of them \v 20 for about years four hundred and fifty.

en.L: The God of this people Israel chose our fathers, and made the people great during [their] stay as foreigners in [the] land of Egypt, and with an uplifted arm {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} led them out of it. \v 18 And for a period of about forty years {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} put up with them in the wilderness. \v 19 And having destroyed seven nations in [the] land of Canaan, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} gave [them] their land as an inheritance, \v 20 for about 450 years.
en.B: The God of this people Israel chose our {{gender:ancestors|fathers}}. During their stay as foreigners in the land of Egypt {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} made the people great, and with a raised arm {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} led them out of that land. \v 18 For about forty years {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} bore with their ways in the desert, \v 19 and after {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} had destroyed seven nations in the land of Canaan, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} gave their land to {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people to possess. \v 20 The whole span was about 450 years.
en.R: The God of the people of Israel chose our {{gender:ancestors|fathers}}. While they were living in Egypt as foreigners, God made them a great people. Then by {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} great power {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} brought them out of Egypt. \v 18 For about forty years {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} was patient with them in the desert. \v 19 Then {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} destroyed seven nations in the land of Canaan, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} gave their land to Israel to keep. \v 20 All of this happened over about 450 years.

es.L: El Dios de este pueblo Israel escogió a nuestros padres, y engrandeció al pueblo durante [su] estancia como extranjeros en [la] tierra de Egipto, y con brazo levantado los sacó de ella. \v 18 Y por un período de unos cuarenta años los soportó en el desierto. \v 19 Y habiendo destruido siete naciones en [la] tierra de Canaán, [les] dio en herencia la tierra de ellas, \v 20 por unos 450 años.
es.B: El Dios de este pueblo de Israel escogió a nuestros {{gender:antepasados|padres}}. Durante su estancia como extranjeros en la tierra de Egipto, engrandeció al pueblo, y con brazo levantado los sacó de aquella tierra. \v 18 Durante unos cuarenta años soportó su conducta en el desierto, \v 19 y después de destruir siete naciones en la tierra de Canaán, dio la tierra de ellas en posesión a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pueblo. \v 20 Todo esto abarcó unos 450 años.
es.R: El Dios del pueblo de Israel escogió a nuestros {{gender:antepasados|padres}}. Mientras vivían como extranjeros en Egipto, Dios hizo de ellos un gran pueblo. Después, con {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} gran poder, los sacó de Egipto. \v 18 Durante unos cuarenta años tuvo paciencia con ellos en el desierto. \v 19 Luego destruyó siete naciones en la tierra de Canaán y dio la tierra de ellas a Israel para que fuera suya. \v 20 Todo esto ocurrió a lo largo de unos 450 años.

fr.L: Le Dieu de ce peuple d’Israël a choisi nos pères, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a fait grandir le peuple pendant [son] séjour en étranger au pays d’Égypte, et à bras levé {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les en a fait sortir. \v 18 Et pendant une période d’environ quarante ans, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les a supportés dans le désert. \v 19 Et, ayant détruit sept nations au pays de Canaan, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} [leur] a donné leur pays en héritage, \v 20 pendant environ 450 ans.
fr.B: Le Dieu de ce peuple d’Israël a choisi nos {{gender:ancêtres|pères}}. Pendant leur séjour d’étrangers au pays d’Égypte, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a fait d’eux un grand peuple, et d’un bras levé {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les a fait sortir de ce pays. \v 18 Pendant environ quarante ans, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a supporté leur conduite dans le désert, \v 19 et après avoir détruit sept nations au pays de Canaan, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a donné leur pays en possession à {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple. \v 20 Tout cela a duré environ 450 ans.
fr.R: Le Dieu du peuple d’Israël a choisi nos {{gender:ancêtres|pères}}. Ils vivaient en Égypte comme des étrangers, et là, Dieu a fait d’eux un grand peuple. Ensuite, par {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} grande puissance, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les a fait sortir d’Égypte. \v 18 Pendant environ quarante ans, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a été patient avec eux dans le désert. \v 19 Puis {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a détruit sept nations au pays de Canaan, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a donné leur pays à Israël pour qu’il le garde. \v 20 Tout cela s’est passé en environ 450 ans.

sw.L: Mungu wa watu hawa Israeli aliwachagua baba zetu, na akawakuza watu hao wakati wa kukaa kwao kama wageni katika nchi ya Misri, na kwa mkono ulioinuliwa akawatoa humo. \v 18 Na kwa muda wa kama miaka arobaini aliwavumilia nyikani. \v 19 Na akiisha kuyaangamiza mataifa saba katika nchi ya Kanaani, aliwarithisha nchi yao \v 20 kwa kama miaka mia nne na hamsini.
sw.B: Mungu wa watu hawa wa Israeli aliwachagua mababu zetu. Walipokuwa wakiishi kama wageni katika nchi ya Misri, aliwafanya kuwa taifa kubwa, na kwa mkono ulioinuliwa akawatoa katika nchi hiyo. \v 18 Kwa muda wa kama miaka arobaini aliivumilia mienendo yao nyikani, \v 19 na baada ya kuyaangamiza mataifa saba katika nchi ya Kanaani, aliwapa watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} nchi yao iwe mali yao. \v 20 Muda huo wote ulikuwa kama miaka mia nne na hamsini.
sw.R: Mungu wa watu wa Israeli aliwachagua mababu zetu. Walipokuwa wakiishi Misri kama wageni, Mungu aliwafanya kuwa taifa kubwa. Kisha kwa uweza {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} mkuu aliwatoa Misri. \v 18 Kwa kama miaka arobaini aliwavumilia jangwani. \v 19 Kisha aliyaangamiza mataifa saba katika nchi ya Kanaani, akawapa Waisraeli nchi yao waimiliki. \v 20 Mambo haya yote yalitukia katika muda wa kama miaka mia nne na hamsini.
