ko.R: 우리는 하나님께서 우리 조상들에게 하신 약속에 관한 기쁜 소식을 여러분에게 전하고 있습니다. \v 33 하나님께서 예수를 일으키심으로써 우리 자녀들을 위하여 그 약속을 지키셨습니다. 시편 둘째 편에 이렇게 쓰여 있습니다. '너는 내 아들이다. 오늘 내가 너의 아버지가 되었다.'

decisions.choice: SBLGNT: "to our children"
decisions.reason: The best early manuscripts read "to our children", which the SBLGNT prints although it reads awkwardly. Many later manuscripts have "to us, their children", which fits Paul's point more smoothly. On the SBLGNT reading Paul speaks as one of the people of Israel and means the present generation, the descendants of the fathers. Reviewers should check this against the apparatus.

decisions.choice: raising up Jesus: either bringing him on the scene, or raising him from the dead
decisions.reason: The verb is used of God raising up a prophet or king (3:22, 7:37) and of the resurrection (2:24, 2:32). Verse 34 goes on to speak of raising him "from the dead", which may mean 13:33 is about sending him, or that 13:34 adds the point that he will never die again.

decisions.choice: Psalm 2:7, God's words to the king he has installed
decisions.reason: In Psalm 2 God says these words to the king on the day he sets him on his throne. Paul applies them to Jesus. Codex Bezae reads "the first psalm", from a time when Psalms 1 and 2 were sometimes counted as one; reviewers should check this against the apparatus.

decisions.choice: today I have begotten you: today I have made you my son, my king
decisions.reason: In the psalm the "today" is the day the king takes his throne. Paul links the words to the resurrection, as Romans 1:4 links Jesus's being shown to be Son of God with his rising.

decisions.choice: ancestors, with "fathers" as the alternative
decisions.reason: "Fathers" here means forebears; Literal keeps the Greek word.

decisions.choice: Today I have become your Father
decisions.reason: "Begotten" is not an everyday word; Readable says the same thing in plain words.

decisions.choice: al levantar a Jesús
decisions.reason: "Levantar" keeps both readings the meaning decision leaves open (m2): God bringing Jesus on the scene, or raising him from the dead. "Resucitar" would choose the second; it is used in 13:34, where the Greek says "from the dead".

decisions.choice: suscité, en suscitant Jésus (every level)
decisions.reason: The meaning note leaves open whether God brought Jesus on the scene or raised him from the dead (m2). French "susciter" can carry both, as English "raise up" does; "ressusciter" or "faire venir" would choose one. Readable keeps it for that reason.

decisions.choice: kwa kumwinua Yesu
decisions.reason: "Kumwinua" (to raise up) keeps both readings the meaning decision leaves open (m2): God bringing Jesus on the scene, or raising him from the dead. "Kumfufua" would choose the second; it is used in 13:34, where the Greek says "from the dead".

decisions.choice: {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}}
decisions.reason: God speaks of himself in the psalm; as the style guide says, a free "mimi" for God takes the span, though the English "I" has none.

decisions.choice: God says "Ta" and speaks to his Son as "Con", capitalised, with no span on "Con", as in the voice from heaven in the Vietnamese Luke 3:22
decisions.reason: Psalm 2:7 is God's word to his Son, and the Vietnamese Luke words the same address without a span ("Con là Con của Ta"); "Con" is a noun of address, as the style guide says.

decisions.choice: "cho chúng ta là con cháu họ" (L); "cho con cháu chúng ta" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The text reads "to our children" (meaning decision), meaning Paul's generation as heirs of the fathers; Literal makes that plain, the other levels keep the Greek's wording.

decisions.choice: "우리 자녀들에게" (L, R); "그들의 자녀인 우리에게" (B)
decisions.reason: The SBLGNT reads "to our children" (meaning decision); Literal and Readable keep it, and Balanced follows the English Balanced's "for our children" with the sense the speech gives it, that the hearers are the fathers' children.

decisions.choice: Psalm 2:7: "너는 내 아들이다. 오늘 내가 너를 낳았다" (L, B); "오늘 내가 너의 아버지가 되었다" (R)
decisions.reason: God's words to the king he has installed (meaning decision), in 해라체; Readable says what "begotten" means, as the English Readable does. "-도다" is the archaic ending the style guide rules out.

source.text: ὅτι δὲ ἀνέστησεν αὐτὸν ἐκ νεκρῶν μηκέτι μέλλοντα ὑποστρέφειν εἰς διαφθοράν, οὕτως εἴρηκεν ὅτι Δώσω ὑμῖν τὰ ὅσια Δαυὶδ τὰ πιστά.

records.literal_gloss: That then he raised him out from [the] dead, no more being about to return to decay, thus he has spoken that, I will give to you the holy [things] of David, the sure [things].

en.L: And that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} raised {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} from [the] dead, no longer about to return to decay, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has spoken thus: 'I will give you the holy [things] of David, the sure [things].'
en.B: And that God raised {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} from the dead, never again to go back to decay, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} declared in these words: 'I will give you the holy blessings of David, the ones that can be trusted.'
en.R: God raised Jesus from death, and {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} body will never decay. God had said this would happen, when {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} said, 'I will give you the holy blessings that I promised to David, and you can trust that I will keep {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} promises.'

es.L: Y en cuanto a que {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} levantó de [los] muertos, para no volver ya más a [la] corrupción, ha hablado así: “{{plural_you:Les|Os}} daré las [cosas] santas de David, las seguras”.
es.B: Y que Dios {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} resucitó de entre los muertos, para no volver nunca a la descomposición, lo declaró con estas palabras: “{{plural_you:Les|Os}} daré las santas bendiciones de David, las que son dignas de confianza”.
es.R: Dios resucitó a Jesús de la muerte, y {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} cuerpo nunca se pudrirá. Dios ya había dicho que esto pasaría cuando dijo: “{{plural_you:Les|Os}} daré las santas bendiciones que prometí a David, y {{plural_you:pueden|podéis}} confiar en que cumpliré {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} promesas”.

fr.L: Et qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}ait ressuscité d’entre les morts pour ne plus retourner à la décomposition, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} l’a dit ainsi : “Je vous donnerai les [choses] saintes de David, les [choses] sûres.”
fr.B: Et que Dieu {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}ait ressuscité des morts, pour ne plus jamais retourner à la décomposition, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} l’a déclaré en ces termes : “Je vous donnerai les saints bienfaits de David, ceux sur lesquels on peut compter.”
fr.R: Dieu a ressuscité Jésus, et {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} corps ne pourrira jamais. Dieu avait annoncé que cela arriverait, quand {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a dit : “Je vous donnerai les saintes bénédictions que j’ai promises à David, et vous pouvez compter sur {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} : je tiendrai {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} promesses.”

sw.L: Na kwamba alimfufua kutoka kwa wafu, asirudi tena kwenye uozo, amesema hivi: 'Nitawapa ninyi [mambo] matakatifu ya Daudi, yaliyo ya kuaminika.'
sw.B: Na kwamba Mungu alimfufua kutoka kwa wafu, asirudi tena kamwe kwenye kuoza, alilitangaza kwa maneno haya: 'Nitawapa baraka takatifu za Daudi, zile zinazoaminika.'
sw.R: Mungu alimfufua Yesu kutoka kifoni, na mwili {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} hautaoza kamwe. Mungu alikuwa amesema kwamba jambo hili lingetukia, aliposema, 'Nitawapa baraka takatifu nilizomwahidi Daudi, nanyi mnaweza kuamini kwamba nitazitimiza ahadi {{deity_pronoun:zangu|Zangu}}.'

vi.L: Và việc {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã khiến Đấng ấy sống lại từ cõi chết, không còn trở về sự hư nát nữa, thì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã phán như vầy: 'Ta sẽ ban cho các ngươi những ơn thánh và chắc chắn đã hứa với Đa-vít.'
vi.B: Còn việc Đức Chúa Trời đã khiến {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sống lại từ cõi chết, không bao giờ còn trở về sự hư nát, thì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã phán như vầy: 'Ta sẽ ban cho các ngươi những phước lành thánh đã hứa với Đa-vít, là những phước lành đáng tin cậy.'
vi.R: Đức Chúa Trời đã khiến Đức Giê-xu sống lại từ cõi chết, và thân thể {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ không bao giờ bị mục nát. Đức Chúa Trời đã nói trước điều này khi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} phán: 'Ta sẽ ban cho các ngươi những phước lành thánh mà {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã hứa với Đa-vít. Các ngươi có thể tin chắc rằng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ giữ lời hứa.'

ko.L: 그리고 [하나님께서] 그분을 죽은 사람들 가운데서 살리셔서 다시는 썩음으로 돌아가지 않게 하신 것에 관하여는, 이렇게 말씀하셨습니다. '내가 다윗의 거룩하고 확실한 것들을 너희에게 주겠다.'
ko.B: 하나님께서 예수를 죽은 사람들 가운데서 살리셔서 다시는 썩지 않게 하신 일에 관하여는 이렇게 말씀하셨습니다. '내가 다윗에게 약속한 거룩하고 확실한 복을 너희에게 주겠다.'
ko.R: 하나님께서는 예수를 죽음에서 살리셨습니다. 그리고 예수의 몸은 다시는 썩지 않을 것입니다. 하나님께서는 이렇게 될 것이라고 말씀하셨습니다. '내가 다윗에게 약속한 거룩한 복을 너희에게 주겠다. 너희는 내가 약속을 꼭 지킨다는 것을 믿을 수 있다.'

decisions.choice: Isaiah 55:3, in the Greek Old Testament
decisions.reason: God promises his people the faithful love he showed to David. The Hebrew reads "the sure mercies of David"; the Greek has "the holy things of David, the sure things".

decisions.choice: the holy things of David, the sure things: the blessings God promised David, which he faithfully keeps
decisions.reason: The plural words mean holy and trustworthy blessings. The word for "holy" is the same root as "Holy One" in the next quotation (13:35), which is why Paul sets the two side by side.

decisions.choice: never to return to decay: never to die again
decisions.reason: Jesus did not decay in the grave (13:37). "Return" means he will never again go back to death.

decisions.choice: you: plural, God's people
decisions.reason: The "you" is plural. The blessings promised to David come to the people through the one God raised.

decisions.choice: three sentences, with the promise explained
decisions.reason: Readable breaks the sentence and says what the holy and sure things are, as the meaning notes explain.

decisions.choice: corrupción (L); descomposición (B); pudrirse (R)
decisions.reason: The word means the decay of a body in the grave (meaning decision m3). "Corrupción" is the traditional word but now suggests bribery; Balanced says "descomposición" and Readable "pudrirse", as the English Readable says "rot". The same in 13:35-37.

decisions.choice: {{plural_you:Les|Os}} daré
decisions.reason: The "you" of the promise is plural, God's people (meaning decision m4), so it takes the plural_you span.

decisions.choice: la décomposition (L, B; also 13:35-37); pourrir (R)
decisions.reason: "La corruption" is the traditional word but today it first means bribery; "la décomposition" says plainly that the body decays. Readable says "pourrir", as the English says "rot".

decisions.choice: uozo (L); kuoza (B, R)
decisions.reason: The word means the decay of a body in the grave (meaning decision m3). "Uozo" and "kuoza" say that plainly; "uharibifu" (destruction, corruption) is broader. The same in 13:35-37.

decisions.choice: "các ngươi" for the plural "you" of Isaiah 55:3, God's people
decisions.reason: As God speaks to his people in the quotations of 2:17-21 and 7:42-43.

decisions.choice: "다윗의 거룩하고 확실한 것들" (L); "다윗에게 약속한 거룩하고 확실한 복" (B)
decisions.reason: The holy things of David, the sure things, are the blessings God promised David and faithfully keeps (meaning decision); Literal keeps the Greek's bare plural, and Balanced says what they are, as the English does. "너희" for the plural "you", God's people (meaning decision).

source.text: διότι καὶ ἐν ἑτέρῳ λέγει· Οὐ δώσεις τὸν ὅσιόν σου ἰδεῖν διαφθοράν·

records.literal_gloss: Therefore also in another he says, Not you will allow the Holy One of you to see decay.

en.L: Therefore {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} also says in another [psalm], 'You will not allow {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} Holy One to see decay.'
en.B: That is why {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} also says in another psalm, 'You will not let {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} Holy One undergo decay.'
en.R: In another psalm God also says, 'You will not let the body of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} Holy One rot.'

es.L: Por eso también dice en otro [salmo]: “No concederás a {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} Santo ver corrupción”.
es.B: Por eso dice también en otro salmo: “No dejarás que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} Santo sufra la descomposición”.
es.R: En otro salmo Dios dice también: “No dejarás que el cuerpo de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} Santo se pudra”.

fr.L: C’est pourquoi {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} dit aussi dans un autre [psaume] : “Tu ne donneras pas à {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} Saint de voir la décomposition.”
fr.B: Voilà pourquoi {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} dit encore dans un autre psaume : “Tu ne laisseras pas {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} Saint connaître la décomposition.”
fr.R: Dans un autre psaume, Dieu dit aussi : “Tu ne laisseras pas pourrir le corps de {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} Saint.”

sw.L: Kwa hiyo pia anasema katika [zaburi] nyingine, 'Hutamruhusu Mtakatifu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} kuona uozo.'
sw.B: Ndiyo maana anasema pia katika zaburi nyingine, 'Hutamwacha Mtakatifu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} aoze.'
sw.R: Katika zaburi nyingine Mungu anasema pia, 'Hutaruhusu mwili wa Mtakatifu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} uoze.'

vi.L: Vì vậy {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cũng phán trong một [thi thiên] khác: 'Chúa sẽ không để Đấng Thánh của Chúa thấy sự hư nát.'
vi.B: Vì thế {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cũng phán trong một thi thiên khác: 'Chúa sẽ không để Đấng Thánh của Chúa phải chịu sự hư nát.'
vi.R: Trong một thi thiên khác, Đức Chúa Trời cũng phán: 'Chúa sẽ không để thân thể của Đấng Thánh của Chúa bị mục nát.'

ko.L: 그러므로 그는 다른 [시편]에서도 말합니다. '주님께서는 주님의 거룩한 분이 썩음을 보게 하지 않으실 것입니다.'
ko.B: 그래서 다른 시편에서도 이렇게 말합니다. '주님께서는 주님의 거룩한 분이 썩지 않게 하실 것입니다.'
ko.R: 다른 시편에서도 하나님께서 이렇게 말씀하십니다. '주님께서는 주님의 거룩한 분의 몸이 썩게 두지 않으실 것입니다.'

decisions.choice: Psalm 16:10, as Peter quoted it in 2:27
decisions.reason: The Greek Old Testament has "decay" where the Hebrew may mean "the pit". Paul's argument, like Peter's, rests on the word decay.

decisions.choice: he says: God speaks in the Scripture
decisions.reason: The psalm is David's, but Paul treats it as God's word; "he" carries on from God in 13:34.

decisions.choice: your Holy One: the one devoted and faithful to God
decisions.reason: The word is the same root as "holy things" in 13:34. As at 2:27, it points to the Messiah.

decisions.choice: the body of ... rot
decisions.reason: Readable says what decay means here, as at 2:27.

decisions.choice: Psalm 16:10 worded as in Peter's quotation (2:27)
decisions.reason: The same verse is quoted twice in Acts; the shared wording lets readers see it.

decisions.choice: the wording of 2:27, Psalm 16:10 as Peter quoted it
decisions.reason: Paul quotes the same verse as Peter (meaning decision), so the Korean repeats it, with the psalmist's 합쇼체 to God. "그는" (L), "말합니다" (B) leave the speaker as the Greek does; Readable names God, as the English Readable does.

source.text: Δαυὶδ μὲν γὰρ ἰδίᾳ γενεᾷ ὑπηρετήσας τῇ τοῦ θεοῦ βουλῇ ἐκοιμήθη καὶ προσετέθη πρὸς τοὺς πατέρας αὐτοῦ καὶ εἶδεν διαφθοράν, ὃν δὲ ὁ θεὸς ἤγειρεν οὐκ εἶδεν διαφθοράν.

records.literal_gloss: David indeed for in his own generation having served the of God purpose fell asleep and was added to the fathers of him and saw decay; \v 37 the [one] however God raised up not did see decay.

en.L: For David, having served the purpose of God in his own generation, fell asleep and was laid with his fathers and saw decay; \v 37 but the one whom God raised up did not see decay.
en.B: For David, after serving God's purpose in his own generation, fell asleep in death; he was laid to rest with his {{gender:ancestors|fathers}}, and his body decayed. \v 37 But the one whom God raised up did not undergo decay.
en.R: David did what God wanted him to do while he was alive. Then he died. He was buried with his {{gender:ancestors|fathers}}, and his body rotted away. \v 37 But God raised Jesus to life, and the body of Jesus did not rot.

es.L: Porque David, habiendo servido en su propia generación al designio de Dios, durmió y fue añadido a sus padres y vio corrupción; \v 37 pero aquel a quien Dios levantó no vio corrupción.
es.B: Porque David, después de servir al propósito de Dios en su propia generación, durmió en la muerte; fue sepultado con sus {{gender:antepasados|padres}} y su cuerpo se descompuso. \v 37 Pero aquel a quien Dios resucitó no sufrió la descomposición.
es.R: David hizo lo que Dios quería mientras vivió. Después murió. Lo enterraron junto a sus {{gender:antepasados|padres}}, y su cuerpo se pudrió. \v 37 Pero Dios resucitó a Jesús, y el cuerpo de Jesús no se pudrió.

fr.L: Car David, ayant servi le dessein de Dieu dans sa propre génération, s’est endormi et a été réuni à ses pères, et il a vu la décomposition ; \v 37 mais celui que Dieu a ressuscité n’a pas vu la décomposition.
fr.B: En effet, David, après avoir servi le dessein de Dieu pour sa propre génération, s’est endormi dans la mort ; il a été enseveli auprès de ses {{gender:ancêtres|pères}}, et son corps s’est décomposé. \v 37 Mais celui que Dieu a ressuscité n’a pas connu la décomposition.
fr.R: David a fait ce que Dieu voulait pendant sa vie. Puis il est mort. On l’a enterré avec ses {{gender:ancêtres|pères}}, et son corps a pourri. \v 37 Mais Dieu a ressuscité Jésus, et le corps de Jésus n’a pas pourri.

sw.L: Kwa maana Daudi, akiisha kulitumikia kusudi la Mungu katika kizazi chake mwenyewe, alilala, akaongezwa kwa baba zake, akaona uozo; \v 37 lakini yule ambaye Mungu alimfufua hakuona uozo.
sw.B: Kwa maana Daudi, baada ya kulitumikia kusudi la Mungu katika kizazi chake, alilala usingizi wa kifo; alizikwa pamoja na mababu zake, na mwili wake ukaoza. \v 37 Lakini yule ambaye Mungu alimfufua hakuoza.
sw.R: Daudi alifanya yale ambayo Mungu alitaka afanye alipokuwa hai. Kisha akafa. Alizikwa pamoja na mababu zake, na mwili wake ukaoza. \v 37 Lakini Mungu alimfufua Yesu, na mwili wa Yesu haukuoza.

vi.L: Vì Đa-vít, sau khi đã phục vụ ý định của Đức Chúa Trời trong đời mình, thì ngủ, được an táng với tổ phụ mình, và đã thấy sự hư nát; \v 37 nhưng Đấng Đức Chúa Trời đã khiến sống lại thì không thấy sự hư nát.
vi.B: Vì Đa-vít, sau khi phục vụ ý định của Đức Chúa Trời trong thế hệ của mình, đã an giấc; ông được an táng bên cạnh tổ tiên mình, và thân thể ông đã bị hư nát. \v 37 Nhưng Đấng mà Đức Chúa Trời đã khiến sống lại thì không phải chịu sự hư nát.
vi.R: Đa-vít đã làm điều Đức Chúa Trời muốn ông làm trong lúc ông còn sống. Rồi ông qua đời. Ông được chôn cất với tổ tiên mình, và thân thể ông đã mục nát. \v 37 Nhưng Đức Chúa Trời đã khiến Đức Giê-xu sống lại, và thân thể của Đức Giê-xu đã không bị mục nát.

ko.L: 다윗은 자기 세대에 하나님의 뜻을 섬긴 뒤에 잠들어 그의 조상들에게 더해졌고 썩음을 보았습니다. \v 37 그러나 하나님께서 살리신 분은 썩음을 보지 않으셨습니다.
ko.B: 다윗은 자기 시대에 하나님의 뜻을 받들어 섬긴 뒤에 잠들어 조상들 곁에 묻혔고, 그의 몸은 썩었습니다. \v 37 그러나 하나님께서 살리신 분은 썩지 않으셨습니다.
ko.R: 다윗은 살아 있는 동안 하나님께서 원하시는 일을 했습니다. 그리고 죽었습니다. 그는 조상들 곁에 묻혔고, 그의 몸은 썩었습니다. \v 37 그러나 하나님께서는 예수를 살리셨고, 예수의 몸은 썩지 않았습니다.

decisions.choice: served God's purpose in his own generation
alternatives: served his own generation, and by God's purpose fell asleep
decisions.reason: "God's purpose" can go with "served" or with "fell asleep". Taking it with "served" gives the plainer sense: David did God's will in his lifetime.

decisions.choice: fell asleep: died
decisions.reason: A common biblical way of speaking of death, as of Stephen (7:60).

decisions.choice: was added to his fathers: was buried and joined his forebears in death
decisions.reason: A phrase from the Old Testament (Judges 2:10; 1 Kings 2:10).

decisions.choice: David decayed, Jesus did not: so the psalm speaks of Jesus
decisions.reason: The same argument as Peter's in 2:29-31.

decisions.choice: ancestors, with "fathers" as the alternative
decisions.reason: "Fathers" here means forebears; Literal keeps the Greek word.

decisions.choice: Jesus
alternatives: the one whom God raised up
decisions.reason: Readable names the one Paul means.

decisions.choice: "ngủ" (L); "an giấc" (B); "qua đời" (R) for "fell asleep", as in 7:60
decisions.reason: "Fell asleep" means died (meaning decision).

source.text: γνωστὸν οὖν ἔστω ὑμῖν, ἄνδρες ἀδελφοί, ὅτι διὰ τούτου ὑμῖν ἄφεσις ἁμαρτιῶν καταγγέλλεται, καὶ ἀπὸ πάντων ὧν οὐκ ἠδυνήθητε ἐν νόμῳ Μωϋσέως δικαιωθῆναι ἐν τούτῳ πᾶς ὁ πιστεύων δικαιοῦται.

records.literal_gloss: Known therefore be it to you, men brothers, that through this [one] to you forgiveness of sins is proclaimed, and from all things from which not you were able in [the] law of Moses to be justified, \v 39 in this [one] everyone who believes is justified.

en.L: Therefore let it be known to you, men, brothers, that through this [one] forgiveness of sins is proclaimed to you, and from all [the things] from which you could not be justified by [the] law of Moses, \v 39 by this [one] everyone who believes is justified.
en.B: So, {{gender:brothers and sisters|brothers}}, you must know this: through this man forgiveness of sins is being announced to you, and from everything the law of Moses could not acquit you of, \v 39 everyone who believes is acquitted through {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.
en.R: So, my {{gender:brothers and sisters|brothers}}, I want you to know this: we are telling you that God forgives your sins because of what Jesus has done. You could not be freed from your guilt by keeping the law of Moses. \v 39 But everyone who believes in Jesus is made right with God and freed from all of it.

es.L: Sea, pues, conocido de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, hombres, hermanos, que por medio de este se {{plural_you:les|os}} anuncia el perdón de pecados, y de todo aquello de lo que no {{plural_you:pudieron|pudisteis}} ser justificados por [la] ley de Moisés, \v 39 en este todo el que cree es justificado.
es.B: Así que, hermanos, {{plural_you:sepan|sabed}} esto: por medio de este hombre se {{plural_you:les|os}} anuncia el perdón de los pecados; y de todo aquello de lo que la ley de Moisés no {{plural_you:los|os}} podía absolver, \v 39 todo el que cree queda absuelto por medio de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}.
es.R: Por eso, hermanos míos, quiero que {{plural_you:sepan|sepáis}} esto: {{plural_you:les|os}} anunciamos que Dios {{plural_you:les|os}} perdona los pecados por lo que Jesús ha hecho. Cumpliendo la ley de Moisés no {{plural_you:podían|podíais}} quedar libres de {{plural_you:su|vuestra}} culpa. \v 39 Pero a todo el que cree en Jesús, Dios lo declara justo y lo libra de toda esa culpa.

fr.L: Qu’il vous soit donc connu, hommes, frères, que par celui-ci le pardon des péchés vous est annoncé, et que de tout ce dont vous n’avez pas pu être justifiés par la Loi de Moïse, \v 39 en celui-ci quiconque croit est justifié.
fr.B: Sachez-le donc, {{gender:frères et sœurs|frères}} : c’est par cet homme que le pardon des péchés vous est annoncé, et de tout ce dont la Loi de Moïse ne pouvait pas vous acquitter, \v 39 quiconque croit est acquitté par {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}.
fr.R: Alors, mes {{gender:frères et sœurs|frères}}, je veux que vous le sachiez : nous vous annonçons que Dieu pardonne vos péchés grâce à ce que Jésus a fait. Vous ne pouviez pas être libérés de votre culpabilité en obéissant à la Loi de Moïse. \v 39 Mais tous ceux qui croient en Jésus sont mis en règle avec Dieu et libérés de tout cela.

sw.L: Basi na ijulikane kwenu, ndugu, kwamba kupitia huyu mnatangaziwa msamaha wa dhambi, na kutoka katika mambo yote ambayo hamkuweza kuhesabiwa haki katika sheria ya Musa, \v 39 katika huyu kila aaminiye anahesabiwa haki.
sw.B: Basi, ndugu, mjue jambo hili: kupitia mtu huyu mnatangaziwa msamaha wa dhambi; na kwa mambo yote ambayo sheria ya Musa haikuweza kuwaondolea hatia, \v 39 kila anayeamini anaondolewa hatia kupitia {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}}.
sw.R: Kwa hiyo, ndugu zangu, nataka mjue jambo hili: tunawatangazia kwamba Mungu anawasamehe dhambi zenu kwa sababu ya yale ambayo Yesu amefanya. Hamkuweza kuondolewa hatia yenu kwa kuishika sheria ya Musa. \v 39 Lakini kila anayemwamini Yesu anafanywa mwenye haki mbele za Mungu na kuondolewa hatia hiyo yote.

vi.L: Vậy, thưa các anh em, xin anh em biết rằng nhờ Đấng này mà sự tha tội được rao truyền cho anh em, và mọi điều mà anh em không thể được xưng công chính bởi luật pháp Môi-se, \v 39 thì nhờ Đấng này, ai tin đều được xưng công chính.
vi.B: Vậy, thưa {{gender:anh chị em|anh em}}, anh em phải biết điều này: nhờ Đấng này mà sự tha tội đang được rao truyền cho anh em, và khỏi mọi điều mà luật pháp Môi-se không thể tha bổng anh em, \v 39 thì nhờ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, ai tin đều được tha bổng.
vi.R: Vì vậy, thưa {{gender:anh chị em|anh em}} của tôi, tôi muốn anh em biết điều này: chúng tôi đang nói cho anh em biết rằng Đức Chúa Trời tha tội cho anh em nhờ những gì Đức Giê-xu đã làm. Anh em không thể được giải thoát khỏi tội lỗi mình bằng cách giữ luật pháp Môi-se. \v 39 Nhưng ai tin Đức Giê-xu đều được Đức Chúa Trời xem là công chính và được giải thoát khỏi mọi tội ấy.

ko.L: 그러므로 형제 여러분, 여러분은 이것을 아십시오. 이분을 통하여 죄 용서가 여러분에게 선포되고 있습니다. 그리고 여러분이 모세의 율법으로 의롭다 함을 받을 수 없었던 모든 일에서, \v 39 이분 안에서 믿는 사람은 누구나 의롭다 함을 받습니다.
ko.B: 그러므로 {{gender:형제자매|형제}} 여러분, 이것을 아셔야 합니다. 이분을 통하여 죄 용서가 여러분에게 전해지고 있습니다. 모세의 율법으로는 여러분이 벗어날 수 없었던 모든 죄에서, \v 39 이분을 믿는 사람은 누구나 의롭다고 인정을 받습니다.
ko.R: 그러니 {{gender:형제자매|형제}} 여러분, 이것을 알아 두십시오. 우리는 예수께서 하신 일 때문에 하나님께서 여러분의 죄를 용서해 주신다는 것을 전하고 있습니다. 여러분은 모세의 율법을 지켜서는 여러분의 죄책에서 벗어날 수 없었습니다. \v 39 그러나 예수를 믿는 사람은 누구나 하나님과 바른 관계가 되고, 그 모든 죄책에서 벗어나게 됩니다.

decisions.choice: men, brothers: as in 13:26, the whole congregation
decisions.reason: Paul repeats the address of 13:26.

decisions.choice: justified from: acquitted of, set free from the guilt of
decisions.reason: With "from", the verb is a legal word: to be declared free of the charges against one. It is the verb Paul uses for being set right with God (Romans 3:24, 3:28; Galatians 2:16). It is not the noun "righteousness".

decisions.choice: the law could never acquit; believing in Jesus does
alternatives: the law acquits of some things, Jesus of the rest
decisions.reason: The words could be read as if the law acquitted of some sins and Jesus of the others. Paul's point is that the law could not do it, and faith in Jesus does it fully (Galatians 2:16).

decisions.choice: by this one: through Jesus
decisions.reason: "This one" points back to Jesus, as at the start of 13:38.

decisions.choice: acquit, acquitted
decisions.reason: Balanced uses a plain legal word for the legal sense, as the meaning note explains; Literal keeps "justified".

decisions.choice: freed from your guilt; made right with God and freed
decisions.reason: Readable says what being justified means, as the meaning note explains.

decisions.choice: brothers and sisters, with "brothers" as the alternative; Literal keeps "men, brothers"
decisions.reason: As at 13:26.

decisions.choice: justificar (L); absolver (B); Dios lo declara justo y lo libra (R)
decisions.reason: As the English: here the verb with "from" means being cleared of guilt (meaning decision m2), so Balanced says "absolver", the courtroom word, and Readable says both what God declares and what he frees from; Literal keeps "justificados".

decisions.choice: justifier (L); acquitter (B); mis en règle avec Dieu et libérés (R)
alternatives: déclarer juste (B), as the term sheet has it
decisions.reason: Literal and Readable follow the term sheet. Here the verb is used with "from" (justified from all the things), in the legal sense of being cleared of a charge (m2); "déclarer juste de tout ce dont…" is not French, so Balanced uses "acquitter", the plain legal word, as the English Balanced uses "acquit".

decisions.choice: kuhesabiwa haki (L); kuondolewa hatia (B); anafanywa mwenye haki ... na kuondolewa hatia (R)
decisions.reason: As the English: with "from", the verb here means being cleared of guilt (meaning decision m2), so Balanced says "kuondolewa hatia" (acquitted); Literal keeps "kuhesabiwa haki", and Readable says both.

decisions.choice: "được xưng công chính" (L); "được tha bổng" (B); "được Đức Chúa Trời xem là công chính và được giải thoát" (R) for "justified from"
decisions.reason: Here "justified from" means acquitted of, set free from the guilt of (meaning decision); Literal keeps the key term of the Vietnamese Romans and Galatians, Balanced the court word, as the English Balanced says "acquit".

decisions.choice: "thưa các anh em" (L); "thưa {{gender:anh chị em|anh em}}" (B, R), as in 13:26
decisions.reason: The whole congregation is addressed (meaning decision).

decisions.choice: "죄 용서"; "의롭다 함을 받다" (L), "의롭다고 인정을 받다" (B), "하나님과 바른 관계가 되고 ... 벗어나다" (R) for dikaioō
decisions.reason: To be justified from is to be acquitted of, set free from the guilt of (meaning decision). Korean keeps the verb of the Korean Romans and Galatians, "의롭다고 인정받다", so Paul's first preached word on it links to his letters, and says the freeing with "벗어나다" (B, R), as the English Balanced says "acquit".

decisions.choice: "형제 여러분" (L); {{gender:형제자매|형제}} 여러분 (B, R)
decisions.reason: As the English: Literal keeps the bare address.

source.text: βλέπετε οὖν μὴ ἐπέλθῃ τὸ εἰρημένον ἐν τοῖς προφήταις·

records.literal_gloss: Take heed therefore lest might come about the [thing] having been said in the prophets,

en.L: Watch out, therefore, so that what has been said in the Prophets does not come upon [you]:
en.B: So be careful, or what was said in the Prophets may come upon you:
en.R: So be careful! Do not let the words of the prophets come true about you. They said,

es.L: {{plural_you:Miren|Mirad}}, pues, que no venga [sobre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}] lo dicho en los Profetas:
es.B: Así que {{plural_you:tengan|tened}} cuidado, no sea que venga sobre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} lo que se dijo en los Profetas:
es.R: ¡Así que {{plural_you:tengan|tened}} cuidado! No {{plural_you:dejen|dejéis}} que las palabras de los profetas se cumplan en {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}. Ellos dijeron:

fr.L: Prenez donc garde que ne vienne [sur vous] ce qui a été dit dans les Prophètes :
fr.B: Faites donc attention, de peur que ne vous arrive ce qui a été dit dans les Prophètes :
fr.R: Alors faites attention ! Ne laissez pas les paroles des prophètes se réaliser contre vous. Ils ont dit :

sw.L: Basi angalieni, lisije [juu yenu] lile lililonenwa katika Manabii:
sw.B: Basi jihadharini, yasije yakawapata yale yaliyosemwa katika Manabii:
sw.R: Kwa hiyo jihadharini! Msiache maneno ya manabii yatimie juu yenu. Walisema,

vi.L: Vậy hãy coi chừng, kẻo điều các nhà tiên tri đã nói xảy đến [cho anh em]:
vi.B: Vậy hãy cẩn thận, kẻo điều đã nói trong sách các nhà tiên tri xảy đến cho anh em:
vi.R: Vậy hãy cẩn thận! Đừng để những lời của các nhà tiên tri trở thành sự thật cho anh em. Các nhà tiên tri đã nói:

ko.L: 그러므로 예언서에서 말한 것이 여러분에게 닥치지 않도록 조심하십시오.
ko.B: 그러니 조심하십시오. 예언서에서 말한 일이 여러분에게 닥칠지도 모릅니다.
ko.R: 그러니 조심하십시오! 예언자들이 한 말이 여러분에게 일어나지 않도록 하십시오. 예언자들은 이렇게 말했습니다.

decisions.choice: in the prophets: in the books of the Prophets
decisions.reason: The quotation comes from Habakkuk, one of the twelve shorter prophetic books, which were counted together.

decisions.choice: lest it come: a warning that it may come upon them
decisions.reason: Paul warns that the words could be fulfilled in them.

decisions.choice: two sentences, and "They said"
decisions.reason: Readable breaks the warning and leads into the quotation.

source.text: Ἴδετε, οἱ καταφρονηταί, καὶ θαυμάσατε καὶ ἀφανίσθητε, ὅτι ἔργον ἐργάζομαι ἐγὼ ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις ὑμῶν, ἔργον ὃ οὐ μὴ πιστεύσητε ἐάν τις ἐκδιηγῆται ὑμῖν.

records.literal_gloss: Behold, the scoffers, and wonder and perish, because a work am working I in the days of you, a work which never not you would believe if someone should declare it to you.

en.L: 'Look, you scoffers, and wonder, and perish, for I am working a work in your days, a work that you will never believe, even if someone tells you in full.'"
en.B: 'See, you who scorn, be astonished and vanish! For I am doing a work in your days, a work you would never believe, even if someone explained it to you.'"
en.R: 'Look, you people who laugh at God! Be amazed and die! I am doing something in your lifetime that you will not believe, even if someone tells you about it.'"

es.L: “{{plural_you:Miren|Mirad}}, despreciadores, y {{plural_you:asómbrense|asombraos}} y {{plural_you:desaparezcan|desapareced}}, porque yo hago una obra en {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} días, una obra que de ningún modo {{plural_you:creerán|creeréis}} aunque alguien {{plural_you:se la cuente|os la cuente}} en detalle”».
es.B: “{{plural_you:Miren|Mirad}}, {{plural_you:ustedes que desprecian|vosotros que despreciáis}}: {{plural_you:asómbrense|asombraos}} y {{plural_you:desaparezcan|desapareced}}. Porque yo hago una obra en {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} días, una obra que nunca {{plural_you:creerían|creeríais}}, aunque alguien {{plural_you:se la explicara|os la explicara}}”».
es.R: “¡{{plural_you:Miren|Mirad}}, {{plural_you:ustedes que se burlan|vosotros que os burláis}} de Dios! ¡{{plural_you:Asómbrense|Asombraos}} y {{plural_you:mueran|morid}}! Estoy haciendo algo mientras {{plural_you:ustedes viven|vosotros vivís}} que no {{plural_you:creerán|creeréis}}, aunque alguien {{plural_you:se lo cuente|os lo cuente}}”».

fr.L: “Voyez, vous les moqueurs, et soyez étonnés, et disparaissez, car moi, j’accomplis une œuvre en vos jours, une œuvre que vous ne croirez jamais si quelqu’un vous la raconte en détail.” »
fr.B: “Regardez, vous qui méprisez, soyez dans la stupeur et disparaissez ! Car je fais en vos jours une œuvre, une œuvre que vous ne croiriez jamais, même si quelqu’un vous l’expliquait.” »
fr.R: “Regardez, vous qui vous moquez de Dieu ! Soyez étonnés et mourez ! Je vais faire pendant votre vie une chose que vous ne croirez pas, même si quelqu’un vous la raconte.” »

sw.L: 'Tazameni, ninyi wenye dharau, mkastaajabu na kuangamia, kwa kuwa {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} ninatenda kazi katika siku zenu, kazi ambayo hamtaiamini kamwe, hata mtu akiwasimulia.'"
sw.B: 'Tazameni, ninyi mnaodharau, mshangae, mkatoweke! Kwa maana ninafanya kazi katika siku zenu, kazi ambayo hamngeiamini kamwe, hata kama mtu angewaeleza.'"
sw.R: 'Tazameni, ninyi mnaomdhihaki Mungu! Shangaeni na mfe! Ninafanya jambo wakati wa maisha yenu ambalo hamtaliamini, hata mtu akiwaambia habari zake.'"

vi.L: 'Hỡi những kẻ khinh lờn, hãy xem, hãy kinh ngạc và bị diệt vong, vì trong đời các ngươi, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} làm một việc, một việc mà dù có ai kể lại tường tận cho các ngươi, các ngươi cũng không bao giờ tin.'"
vi.B: 'Hỡi những kẻ khinh lờn, hãy xem, hãy kinh ngạc và biến mất đi! Vì trong đời các ngươi, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} làm một việc, một việc mà các ngươi sẽ không bao giờ tin, dù có người giải thích cho các ngươi.'"
vi.R: 'Hỡi những người chế nhạo Đức Chúa Trời, hãy xem đây! Hãy kinh ngạc và chết đi! Trong đời các ngươi, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đang làm một việc mà các ngươi sẽ không tin, dù có người kể cho các ngươi nghe.'"

ko.L: '보아라, 비웃는 사람들아, 놀라고 망하여라. 내가 너희 시대에 한 가지 일을 행할 것인데, 누가 너희에게 자세히 말해 주어도 너희가 결코 믿지 못할 일이다.'"
ko.B: '보아라, 비웃는 사람들아! 놀라고 사라져라. 내가 너희 시대에 한 가지 일을 할 것인데, 누가 너희에게 설명해 주어도 너희가 도무지 믿지 못할 일이다.'"
ko.R: '보아라, 하나님을 비웃는 사람들아! 놀라고 죽어라! 내가 너희가 살아 있는 동안에 한 가지 일을 할 것이다. 누가 너희에게 그 일을 알려 주어도 너희는 믿지 못할 것이다.'"

decisions.choice: Habakkuk 1:5, in the Greek Old Testament
decisions.reason: The Hebrew reads "Look among the nations"; the Greek has "Look, you scoffers". In Habakkuk the astonishing work was God bringing the Babylonians in judgment. Paul applies the warning to those who reject God's work in Jesus.

decisions.choice: perish: vanish, be destroyed
decisions.reason: The verb means to disappear or be destroyed.

decisions.choice: you will never believe: a strong denial
decisions.reason: The two negatives make it emphatic.

decisions.choice: you people who laugh at God
decisions.reason: Readable says plainly what scoffers do.

decisions.choice: God says "Ta" and "các ngươi" in Habakkuk 1:5
decisions.reason: As in the other words of God quoted in Acts (2:17-21; 7:42-43; 13:34).

decisions.choice: Habakkuk 1:5 with God speaking in 해라체 ("사람들아", "망하여라")
decisions.reason: As God speaks through the other prophets in Acts (2:17; 7:42); the warning is God's own.

source.text: Ἐξιόντων δὲ αὐτῶν παρεκάλουν εἰς τὸ μεταξὺ σάββατον λαληθῆναι αὐτοῖς τὰ ῥήματα ταῦτα.

records.literal_gloss: Going out then they, they were begging on the next Sabbath to be spoken to them the words these.

en.L: And as they were going out, they were begging that these words be spoken to them on the next Sabbath.
en.B: As Paul and Barnabas were going out, the people kept urging them to speak about these things again on the next Sabbath.
en.R: As Paul and Barnabas were leaving the synagogue, the people begged them to come back the next Sabbath and tell them more about these things.

es.L: Y al salir ellos, rogaban que el sábado siguiente se les hablara de estas palabras.
es.B: Cuando Pablo y Bernabé salían, la gente les insistía en que el sábado siguiente volvieran a hablarles de estas cosas.
es.R: Cuando Pablo y Bernabé salían de la sinagoga, la gente les rogó que volvieran el sábado siguiente y les contaran más de estas cosas.

fr.L: Et, comme ils sortaient, ils demandaient avec insistance que ces paroles leur soient dites le sabbat suivant.
fr.B: Comme Paul et Barnabas sortaient, les gens les prièrent avec insistance de leur reparler de ces choses le sabbat suivant.
fr.R: Pendant que Paul et Barnabas sortaient de la synagogue, les gens les ont suppliés de revenir le sabbat suivant et de leur en dire plus.

sw.L: Na walipokuwa wakitoka, walikuwa wakiwasihi kwamba maneno haya yanenwe kwao Sabato iliyofuata.
sw.B: Paulo na Barnaba walipokuwa wakitoka, watu waliendelea kuwasihi wazungumze tena juu ya mambo hayo Sabato iliyofuata.
sw.R: Paulo na Barnaba walipokuwa wakitoka sinagogini, watu waliwasihi warudi Sabato iliyofuata na kuwaambia zaidi juu ya mambo hayo.

vi.L: Khi hai ông ra về, người ta nài xin hai ông ngày Sa-bát sau lại giảng cho họ những lời ấy.
vi.B: Khi Phao-lô và Ba-na-ba ra về, dân chúng cứ nài xin hai ông ngày Sa-bát tới lại nói cho họ nghe về những điều ấy.
vi.R: Khi Phao-lô và Ba-na-ba rời khỏi nhà hội, dân chúng nài xin hai ông ngày Sa-bát tới trở lại và nói cho họ biết thêm về những điều ấy.

ko.L: 그런데 그들이 나갈 때에, 사람들은 다음 안식일에도 이 말씀을 자기들에게 해 달라고 간청했다.
ko.B: 바울과 바나바가 회당을 나갈 때, 사람들은 다음 안식일에도 이 일에 관하여 말해 달라고 거듭 청했다.
ko.R: 바울과 바나바가 회당을 떠날 때, 사람들은 다음 안식일에 다시 와서 이 일에 관하여 더 이야기해 달라고 부탁했다.

decisions.choice: they were going out; the people were begging
decisions.reason: The Greek does not name either group. Those leaving are most naturally Paul and Barnabas; those who ask are the people of the synagogue.

decisions.choice: the next Sabbath
decisions.reason: The word can mean "between" or "next". 13:44 shows the next Sabbath is meant.

decisions.choice: SBLGNT: "as they were going out, they were begging"
alternatives: "as the Jews were going out of the synagogue, the Gentiles begged"
decisions.reason: Many later manuscripts, followed by the King James Version, name the Jews as leaving and the Gentiles as asking. The earlier manuscripts name neither. Reviewers should check this against the apparatus.

decisions.choice: Paul and Barnabas; the people
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name the two groups, as the meaning note explains.

source.text: λυθείσης δὲ τῆς συναγωγῆς ἠκολούθησαν πολλοὶ τῶν Ἰουδαίων καὶ τῶν σεβομένων προσηλύτων τῷ Παύλῳ καὶ τῷ Βαρναβᾷ, οἵτινες προσλαλοῦντες αὐτοῖς ἔπειθον· αὐτοὺς προσμένειν τῇ χάριτι τοῦ θεοῦ.

records.literal_gloss: Having broken up then the synagogue, followed many of the Jews and of the worshiping converts Paul and Barnabas, who speaking to them were persuading them to continue in the grace of God.

en.L: And when the synagogue [meeting] had broken up, many of the Jews and of the worshiping proselytes followed Paul and Barnabas, who, speaking to them, were urging them to continue in the grace of God.
en.B: After the gathering broke up, many Jews and converts who worshiped God went along with Paul and Barnabas, who talked with them and kept persuading them to remain in the grace of God.
en.R: When the meeting was over, many Jews followed Paul and Barnabas. So did many Gentiles who had become Jews and worshiped God. Paul and Barnabas talked with them and urged them to keep on trusting in the grace of God.

es.L: Y disuelta la [reunión de la] sinagoga, muchos de los judíos y de los prosélitos que adoraban [a Dios] siguieron a Pablo y a Bernabé, los cuales, hablándoles, los exhortaban a permanecer en la gracia de Dios.
es.B: Terminada la reunión, muchos judíos y convertidos que adoraban a Dios acompañaron a Pablo y a Bernabé, quienes conversaban con ellos y los animaban una y otra vez a permanecer en la gracia de Dios.
es.R: Cuando terminó la reunión, muchos judíos siguieron a Pablo y a Bernabé. También los siguieron muchos gentiles que se habían hecho judíos y adoraban a Dios. Pablo y Bernabé hablaron con ellos y los animaron a seguir confiando en la gracia de Dios.

fr.L: Et, quand [la réunion de] la synagogue se fut dispersée, beaucoup de Juifs et de prosélytes pieux suivirent Paul et Barnabas, qui, leur parlant, les persuadaient de demeurer dans la grâce de Dieu.
fr.B: Quand l’assemblée se fut séparée, beaucoup de Juifs et de convertis qui adoraient Dieu accompagnèrent Paul et Barnabas ; ceux-ci s’entretenaient avec eux et les pressaient de rester attachés à la grâce de Dieu.
fr.R: Quand la réunion a été finie, beaucoup de Juifs ont suivi Paul et Barnabas. Beaucoup de gens d’autres peuples, qui s’étaient convertis à la religion juive et qui adoraient Dieu, les ont suivis aussi. Paul et Barnabas leur ont parlé et les ont encouragés à continuer à compter sur la grâce de Dieu.

sw.L: Na [mkutano wa] sinagogi ulipotawanyika, wengi wa Wayahudi na wa waongofu waliokuwa wakiabudu waliwafuata Paulo na Barnaba, ambao, wakizungumza nao, walikuwa wakiwashawishi kudumu katika neema ya Mungu.
sw.B: Baada ya mkutano kumalizika, Wayahudi wengi na waongofu waliomwabudu Mungu waliandamana na Paulo na Barnaba. Paulo na Barnaba walizungumza nao, wakaendelea kuwahimiza wadumu katika neema ya Mungu.
sw.R: Mkutano ulipokwisha, Wayahudi wengi waliwafuata Paulo na Barnaba. Watu wengi wa mataifa waliokuwa wamekuwa Wayahudi na kumwabudu Mungu walifanya vivyo hivyo. Paulo na Barnaba walizungumza nao, wakawahimiza waendelee kuitegemea neema ya Mungu.

vi.L: Khi buổi nhóm trong nhà hội tan, nhiều người Do Thái và những người nhập đạo Do Thái thờ phượng Đức Chúa Trời đi theo Phao-lô và Ba-na-ba; hai ông nói chuyện với họ và khuyên họ tiếp tục ở trong ân điển của Đức Chúa Trời.
vi.B: Khi buổi nhóm tan, nhiều người Do Thái và những người ngoại đã theo đạo Do Thái, là những người thờ phượng Đức Chúa Trời, đi theo Phao-lô và Ba-na-ba. Hai ông trò chuyện với họ và tiếp tục khuyên họ hãy luôn ở trong ân điển của Đức Chúa Trời.
vi.R: Khi buổi nhóm kết thúc, nhiều người Do Thái đi theo Phao-lô và Ba-na-ba. Nhiều người ngoại đã trở thành người Do Thái và thờ phượng Đức Chúa Trời cũng đi theo. Phao-lô và Ba-na-ba nói chuyện với họ và khuyên họ hãy tiếp tục tin cậy ân điển của Đức Chúa Trời.

ko.L: 그리고 회당 [모임]이 끝나자, 많은 유대인과 경건한 개종자들이 바울과 바나바를 따라갔다. 두 사람은 그들과 이야기하며 하나님의 은혜 안에 계속 머물라고 권했다.
ko.B: 모임이 끝나자, 많은 유대인과 하나님을 섬기는 개종자들이 바울과 바나바를 따라갔다. 두 사람은 그들과 이야기하면서 하나님의 은혜 안에 계속 머물러 있으라고 설득했다.
ko.R: 모임이 끝난 뒤에, 많은 유대인이 바울과 바나바를 따라갔다. 유대교로 개종하여 하나님을 섬기는 다른 민족 사람들도 많이 따라갔다. 바울과 바나바는 그들과 이야기하면서, 계속 하나님의 은혜를 의지하라고 권했다.

decisions.choice: worshiping proselytes: Gentiles who had become Jews by conversion
decisions.reason: A proselyte was a Gentile who took on the law of Moses in full (2:10, 6:5). Luke here joins the word with "worshiping", which he elsewhere uses of the God-fearers (16:14, 17:4); the line between the groups may not be sharp.

decisions.choice: continue in the grace of God: keep relying on God's kindness that they had now received
decisions.reason: The grace of God is his undeserved kindness in Jesus, which they had welcomed in the message (11:23, 14:3).

decisions.choice: who: Paul and Barnabas, urging the people
alternatives: the people urging Paul and Barnabas
decisions.reason: The nearer names are Paul and Barnabas, and the urging to continue in grace fits them.

decisions.choice: Gentiles who had become Jews; keep on trusting in
decisions.reason: Readable explains the word proselyte and what continuing in grace means, as the meaning notes explain.

decisions.choice: prosélitos (L); convertidos (B)
decisions.reason: Gentiles who had become Jews by conversion (meaning decision m1). Literal keeps the technical word; Balanced says "convertidos", and Readable says what they were, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "những người nhập đạo Do Thái thờ phượng Đức Chúa Trời" (L); "những người ngoại đã theo đạo Do Thái, là những người thờ phượng Đức Chúa Trời" (B)
alternatives: "những người kính sợ Đức Chúa Trời"
decisions.reason: These are proselytes, Gentiles who had become Jews (meaning decision), as in 2:11, not the God-fearers of 13:16, so they are named with the words of 2:11.

decisions.choice: "경건한 개종자들" (L), "하나님을 섬기는 개종자들" (B), "유대교로 개종하여 하나님을 섬기는 다른 민족 사람들" (R); "은혜"
decisions.reason: Worshiping proselytes are Gentiles who had become Jews by conversion (meaning decision), worded with "개종자" as in 2:11; "섬기다" for sebomai, kept apart from the God-fearers of 13:16 ("두려워하다", "경외하다").

source.text: Τῷ δὲ ἐρχομένῳ σαββάτῳ σχεδὸν πᾶσα ἡ πόλις συνήχθη ἀκοῦσαι τὸν λόγον τοῦ κυρίου.

records.literal_gloss: On the now coming Sabbath almost all the city was gathered together to hear the word of the Lord.

en.L: And on the coming Sabbath almost the whole city was gathered together to hear the word of the Lord.
en.B: The following Sabbath nearly the entire city came together to hear the word of the Lord.
en.R: On the next Sabbath almost everyone in the city came to hear the word of the Lord.

es.L: Y el sábado venidero casi toda la ciudad se juntó para oír la palabra del Señor.
es.B: El sábado siguiente se reunió casi toda la ciudad para escuchar la palabra del Señor.
es.R: El sábado siguiente, casi toda la gente de la ciudad vino a escuchar la palabra del Señor.

fr.L: Et, le sabbat suivant, presque toute la ville se rassembla pour entendre la parole du Seigneur.
fr.B: Le sabbat d’après, presque toute la ville se réunit pour entendre la parole du Seigneur.
fr.R: Le sabbat suivant, presque tous les habitants de la ville sont venus écouter la parole du Seigneur.

sw.L: Na Sabato iliyofuata karibu mji wote ulikusanyika kusikia neno la Bwana.
sw.B: Sabato iliyofuata karibu mji mzima ulikusanyika kusikiliza neno la Bwana.
sw.R: Sabato iliyofuata, karibu kila mtu mjini alikuja kusikia neno la Bwana.

vi.L: Ngày Sa-bát sau, gần như cả thành nhóm lại để nghe lời Chúa.
vi.B: Ngày Sa-bát tiếp theo, gần như cả thành đều đến nghe lời Chúa.
vi.R: Ngày Sa-bát tới, hầu như mọi người trong thành đều đến nghe lời của Chúa.

ko.L: 그리고 다음 안식일에 거의 온 성이 주님의 말씀을 들으려고 모였다.
ko.B: 다음 안식일에는 거의 온 성 사람들이 주님의 말씀을 들으려고 모여들었다.
ko.R: 다음 안식일에는 그 도시의 거의 모든 사람이 주님의 말씀을 들으러 왔다.

decisions.choice: almost the whole city: a great crowd, Jews and Gentiles alike
decisions.reason: The crowds in 13:45 and the Gentiles in 13:48 show that many beyond the synagogue came.

decisions.choice: SBLGNT: "the word of the Lord"
decisions.reason: Some important manuscripts read "the word of God". The meaning is much the same. Reviewers should check this against the apparatus.

source.text: ἰδόντες δὲ οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι τοὺς ὄχλους ἐπλήσθησαν ζήλου καὶ ἀντέλεγον τοῖς ὑπὸ Παύλου λαλουμένοις βλασφημοῦντες.

records.literal_gloss: Having seen however the Jews the crowds were filled with jealousy and were contradicting the things by Paul being spoken, blaspheming.

en.L: But when the Jews saw the crowds, they were filled with jealousy and began contradicting the things spoken by Paul, blaspheming.
en.B: But when the Jews saw the crowds, jealousy filled them, and they spoke against what Paul was saying and reviled him.
en.R: But when the Jews there saw all those people, they became jealous. They argued against what Paul was saying, and they said terrible things about him.

es.L: Pero los judíos, al ver las multitudes, se llenaron de celos y contradecían lo que Pablo decía, blasfemando.
es.B: Pero cuando los judíos vieron las multitudes, se llenaron de celos, y hablaban contra lo que Pablo decía y lo insultaban.
es.R: Pero cuando los judíos de allí vieron a toda esa gente, se pusieron celosos. Discutían contra lo que Pablo decía y hablaban muy mal de él.

fr.L: Mais les Juifs, voyant les foules, furent remplis de jalousie et contredisaient ce que disait Paul, en blasphémant.
fr.B: Mais quand les Juifs virent ces foules, ils furent pris de jalousie ; ils contredisaient les paroles de Paul et l’injuriaient.
fr.R: Mais quand les Juifs de cette ville ont vu tous ces gens, ils sont devenus jaloux. Ils se sont opposés à ce que Paul disait, et ils ont dit des choses horribles contre lui.

sw.L: Lakini Wayahudi walipoyaona makutano, walijaa wivu, wakawa wakiyapinga maneno yaliyosemwa na Paulo, wakikufuru.
sw.B: Lakini Wayahudi walipoyaona makutano hayo, walijawa na wivu, wakayapinga yale aliyokuwa akisema Paulo na kumtukana.
sw.R: Lakini Wayahudi wa huko walipowaona watu hao wote, waliona wivu. Walibishana na maneno ya Paulo, na wakasema mambo mabaya sana juu yake.

vi.L: Nhưng khi người Do Thái thấy đoàn dân đông, họ đầy lòng ghen tức và phản bác những điều Phao-lô nói, lại còn xúc phạm.
vi.B: Nhưng khi thấy đám đông, người Do Thái đầy lòng ghen tức. Họ chống đối những điều Phao-lô nói và nhục mạ ông.
vi.R: Nhưng khi những người Do Thái ở đó thấy những đám đông ấy, họ trở nên ghen tức. Họ cãi lại những gì Phao-lô nói, và nói những điều xấu xa về ông.

ko.L: 그러나 유대인들은 무리를 보고 시기심이 가득하여, 바울이 하는 말을 반박하며 모독했다.
ko.B: 그러나 유대인들은 그 무리를 보고 시기심이 가득 차서, 바울이 하는 말에 반대하고 그를 헐뜯었다.
ko.R: 그러나 그곳의 유대인들은 그 많은 사람을 보고 시기가 났다. 그들은 바울이 하는 말에 반대하고, 바울에 관하여 나쁜 말을 했다.

decisions.choice: blaspheming: speaking abusively, against Paul and his message
decisions.reason: The word means to slander or revile. Because the message is about Jesus, reviling it may also be speaking against God, as Luke implies (18:6, 26:11).

decisions.choice: jealousy: resentment at the crowds drawn to Paul
decisions.reason: The word can mean zeal or jealousy. Seeing the crowds is what provokes it, as in 5:17.

decisions.choice: the Jews: those Jews of the synagogue who opposed Paul
decisions.reason: Many Jews had followed Paul gladly (13:43). Luke means those who now opposed him.

decisions.choice: reviled him
decisions.reason: Balanced follows the meaning chosen; Literal keeps the Greek word.

decisions.choice: the Jews there
decisions.reason: Readable makes clear that the Jews of that synagogue are meant, not all Jews, as the meaning note explains. It does not narrow them to the leaders, which the Greek does not say.

decisions.choice: wakikufuru (L); kumtukana (B)
decisions.reason: The abuse was aimed at Paul and his message (meaning decision m1, uncertain). Literal keeps "kufuru", as the English Literal keeps "blaspheming"; Balanced says "kumtukana" (reviled him), since "kufuru" in Swahili is speech against God.

decisions.choice: "xúc phạm" (L); "nhục mạ ông" (B) for "blaspheming"
decisions.reason: Speaking abusively, against Paul and his message (meaning decision); "phạm thượng" would say they spoke against God.

decisions.choice: "모독하다" (L), "헐뜯다" (B), "나쁜 말을 하다" (R) for blasphēmeō
decisions.reason: Blaspheming here is speaking abusively, against Paul and his message (meaning decision); Literal keeps the word of 6:11, and Balanced and Readable say it was aimed at Paul, as the English does.

source.text: παρρησιασάμενοί τε ὁ Παῦλος καὶ ὁ Βαρναβᾶς εἶπαν· Ὑμῖν ἦν ἀναγκαῖον πρῶτον λαληθῆναι τὸν λόγον τοῦ θεοῦ· ἐπειδὴ ἀπωθεῖσθε αὐτὸν καὶ οὐκ ἀξίους κρίνετε ἑαυτοὺς τῆς αἰωνίου ζωῆς, ἰδοὺ στρεφόμεθα εἰς τὰ ἔθνη·

records.literal_gloss: Having spoken boldly also Paul and Barnabas said, To you it was necessary first to be spoken the word of God; since you thrust away it and not worthy judge yourselves of the eternal life, behold, we are turning to the Gentiles.

en.L: And Paul and Barnabas, speaking boldly, said, "It was necessary that the word of God be spoken to you first. Since you thrust it away and judge yourselves unworthy of eternal life, look, we are turning to the Gentiles.
en.B: Paul and Barnabas spoke out boldly: "The word of God had to be spoken to you first. Since you push it away and judge yourselves unworthy of eternal life, see, we are turning to the Gentiles.
en.R: Then Paul and Barnabas spoke bravely. They said, "We had to tell God's message to you Jews first. But you refuse to listen. You are showing that you do not think you are good enough for eternal life. So now we will go to the Gentiles.

es.L: Y hablando con valentía, Pablo y Bernabé dijeron: «Era necesario que a {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} primero se {{plural_you:les|os}} hablara la palabra de Dios; ya que la {{plural_you:rechazan|rechazáis}} y no {{plural_you:se juzgan|os juzgáis}} dignos de la vida eterna, {{plural_you:miren|mirad}}, nos volvemos a los gentiles.
es.B: Pablo y Bernabé respondieron con valentía: «Era necesario que la palabra de Dios se {{plural_you:les|os}} anunciara primero a {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}. Pero ya que la {{plural_you:rechazan|rechazáis}} y {{plural_you:se juzgan|os juzgáis}} indignos de la vida eterna, {{plural_you:miren|mirad}}, nos vamos a los gentiles.
es.R: Entonces Pablo y Bernabé hablaron con valentía. Dijeron: «Teníamos que {{plural_you:darles|daros}} el mensaje de Dios primero a {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, los judíos. Pero {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} no {{plural_you:quieren|queréis}} escuchar. {{plural_you:Están|Estáis}} mostrando que no {{plural_you:se consideran|os consideráis}} dignos de la vida eterna. Por eso ahora nos vamos a los gentiles.

fr.L: Et Paul et Barnabas, parlant avec assurance, dirent : « C’est à vous qu’il était nécessaire que la parole de Dieu soit annoncée d’abord. Puisque vous la repoussez et que vous vous jugez vous-mêmes indignes de la vie éternelle, voici, nous nous tournons vers les nations.
fr.B: Paul et Barnabas déclarèrent avec hardiesse : « Il fallait que la parole de Dieu vous soit annoncée d’abord. Puisque vous la rejetez et que vous vous jugez indignes de la vie éternelle, eh bien, nous nous tournons vers les non-Juifs.
fr.R: Alors Paul et Barnabas ont parlé avec courage. Ils ont dit : « Nous devions d’abord annoncer le message de Dieu à vous, les Juifs. Mais vous refusez d’écouter. Vous montrez que vous ne vous croyez pas dignes de la vie éternelle. Alors maintenant, nous allons vers les non-Juifs.

sw.L: Na Paulo na Barnaba, wakinena kwa ujasiri, walisema, "Ilikuwa lazima neno la Mungu linenwe kwenu kwanza; kwa kuwa mnalisukuma mbali na kujihukumu wenyewe kuwa hamstahili uzima wa milele, tazama, tunawageukia watu wa mataifa.
sw.B: Paulo na Barnaba walizungumza kwa ujasiri: "Ilikuwa lazima neno la Mungu linenwe kwenu kwanza. Kwa kuwa mnalikataa na kujiona wenyewe kuwa hamstahili uzima wa milele, tazameni, sasa tunawageukia watu wa mataifa.
sw.R: Kisha Paulo na Barnaba walisema kwa ujasiri, "Ilitubidi kuwaambia ninyi Wayahudi ujumbe wa Mungu kwanza. Lakini mnakataa kusikiliza. Mnaonyesha kwamba hamjioni kuwa mnastahili uzima wa milele. Kwa hiyo sasa tutakwenda kwa watu wa mataifa.

vi.L: Phao-lô và Ba-na-ba dạn dĩ nói: "Lời Đức Chúa Trời cần phải được rao giảng cho các ông trước hết; nhưng vì các ông khước từ lời ấy và tự xét mình không xứng đáng nhận sự sống đời đời, nên kìa, chúng tôi quay sang các dân ngoại.
vi.B: Phao-lô và Ba-na-ba dạn dĩ tuyên bố: "Lời Đức Chúa Trời phải được rao giảng cho các ông trước. Nhưng vì các ông khước từ lời ấy và tự cho mình không xứng đáng nhận sự sống đời đời, nên bây giờ chúng tôi quay sang các dân ngoại.
vi.R: Bấy giờ Phao-lô và Ba-na-ba mạnh dạn nói: "Chúng tôi phải nói sứ điệp của Đức Chúa Trời cho các ông là người Do Thái trước. Nhưng các ông không chịu nghe. Các ông đang cho thấy rằng các ông nghĩ mình không xứng đáng nhận sự sống đời đời. Vì vậy bây giờ chúng tôi sẽ đến với những người không phải Do Thái.

ko.L: 그러자 바울과 바나바가 담대하게 말했다. "하나님의 말씀을 먼저 여러분에게 전해야 했습니다. 그런데 여러분이 그것을 밀어내고 스스로 영원한 생명을 얻기에 합당하지 않다고 판단하니, 보십시오, 우리는 이방 사람들에게로 갑니다.
ko.B: 바울과 바나바가 담대하게 말했다. "하나님의 말씀을 먼저 여러분에게 전해야 했습니다. 그러나 여러분이 그 말씀을 거부하고, 스스로 영원한 생명을 얻기에 합당하지 않다고 판단하니, 이제 우리는 이방 사람들에게로 가겠습니다.
ko.R: 그러자 바울과 바나바가 용감하게 말했다. "우리는 하나님의 말씀을 먼저 여러분 유대 사람들에게 전해야 했습니다. 그러나 여러분은 듣기를 거부합니다. 여러분은 스스로 영원한 생명을 얻을 만한 사람이 아니라는 것을 보여 주고 있습니다. 그래서 이제 우리는 유대인이 아닌 사람들에게 가겠습니다.

decisions.choice: to you first: God's word was to come first to Israel
decisions.reason: Jesus sent his witnesses starting from Jerusalem (1:8; Luke 24:47), and Paul writes "to the Jew first" (Romans 1:16). Paul keeps going first to the synagogue after this (14:1, 17:1-2).

decisions.choice: you judge yourselves unworthy of eternal life: by your own choice you show you will not have it
decisions.reason: Paul says their rejection is their own verdict on themselves.

decisions.choice: eternal life: the life of the age to come
decisions.reason: As in 13:48, life with God that does not end.

decisions.choice: we are turning to the Gentiles: in this city
alternatives: they will never again preach to Jews
decisions.reason: In the next town they go first to the synagogue again (14:1).

decisions.choice: you Jews
decisions.reason: Readable names the hearers, who are the Jews of 13:45.

decisions.choice: you are showing that you do not think you are good enough
decisions.reason: Readable explains the idiom, as the meaning note explains.

decisions.choice: Paul and Barnabas speak to the Jews who oppose them as "các ông"
decisions.reason: The "anh em" of the synagogue speech gives way to the distant "các ông" when the hearers reject the message, as the apostles speak to the council.

decisions.choice: "sự sống đời đời" for eternal life at every level
decisions.reason: The key term of the style guide.

decisions.choice: "영원한 생명" at every level; "이방 사람들" (L, B), "유대인이 아닌 사람들" (R)
decisions.reason: The style guide gives "영원한 생명" at every level (section 6); Gentiles as settled at 4:27. Paul and Barnabas keep the formal style even in this rebuke, as Stephen does (7:51).

source.text: οὕτως γὰρ ἐντέταλται ἡμῖν ὁ κύριος· Τέθεικά σε εἰς φῶς ἐθνῶν τοῦ εἶναί σε εἰς σωτηρίαν ἕως ἐσχάτου τῆς γῆς.

records.literal_gloss: Thus for has commanded us the Lord, I have set you for a light of nations, to be you for salvation to [the] end of the earth.

en.L: For thus the Lord has commanded us: 'I have set you as a light for [the] nations, that you may be for salvation to [the] end of the earth.'"
en.B: For this is the command the Lord has given us: 'I have set you as a light for the nations, so that you may be the means of salvation to the farthest part of the earth.'"
en.R: This is what the Lord told us to do when {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} said, 'I have made you a light for the nations. You will bring salvation to people all over the earth.'"

es.L: Porque así nos lo ha mandado el Señor: “Te he puesto por luz de [las] naciones, para que tú seas para salvación hasta [el] confín de la tierra”».
es.B: Porque esto es lo que el Señor nos ha mandado: “Te he puesto como luz para las naciones, para que seas el medio de salvación hasta el lugar más lejano de la tierra”».
es.R: Esto es lo que el Señor nos mandó hacer cuando dijo: “Te he hecho luz para las naciones. Llevarás la salvación a la gente de toda la tierra”».

fr.L: Car ainsi nous l’a ordonné le Seigneur : “Je t’ai placé comme lumière des nations, pour que tu sois [source de] salut jusqu’à l’extrémité de la terre.” »
fr.B: Car voici l’ordre que le Seigneur nous a donné : “Je t’ai placé comme une lumière pour les nations, pour que tu apportes le salut jusqu’aux extrémités de la terre.” »
fr.R: Voici ce que le Seigneur nous a demandé de faire, quand {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a dit : “J’ai fait de toi une lumière pour les nations. Tu apporteras le salut aux gens du monde entier.” »

sw.L: Kwa maana ndivyo Bwana alivyotuamuru: 'Nimekuweka uwe nuru ya mataifa, ili uwe [chombo cha] wokovu mpaka mwisho wa dunia.'"
sw.B: Kwa maana hii ndiyo amri ambayo Bwana ametupa: 'Nimekuweka kuwa nuru kwa mataifa, ili uwe njia ya wokovu mpaka sehemu za mbali kabisa za dunia.'"
sw.R: Hivi ndivyo Bwana alivyotuagiza alipotuambia, 'Nimekufanya kuwa nuru kwa mataifa. Utawaletea wokovu watu wa dunia nzima.'"

vi.L: Vì Chúa đã truyền cho chúng tôi như vầy: 'Ta đã lập con làm ánh sáng cho các dân ngoại, để con đem sự cứu rỗi đến tận cùng trái đất.'"
vi.B: Vì đây là mệnh lệnh Chúa đã truyền cho chúng tôi: 'Ta đã lập con làm ánh sáng cho các dân tộc, để con đem sự cứu rỗi đến tận cùng trái đất.'"
vi.R: Đây là điều Chúa đã bảo chúng tôi làm, khi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} phán: 'Ta đã lập con làm ánh sáng cho các dân tộc. Con sẽ đem sự cứu rỗi đến cho mọi người trên khắp trái đất.'"

ko.L: 주님께서 우리에게 이렇게 명령하셨기 때문입니다. '내가 너를 민족들의 빛으로 세웠다. 네가 땅끝까지 구원이 되게 하려는 것이다.'"
ko.B: 주님께서 우리에게 이렇게 명령하셨습니다. '내가 너를 이방 사람들의 빛으로 세웠다. 너는 땅끝까지 구원을 이르게 할 것이다.'"
ko.R: 주님께서 우리에게 이렇게 하라고 말씀하셨습니다. '내가 너를 모든 민족의 빛으로 삼았다. 너는 온 땅의 사람들에게 구원을 가져다줄 것이다.'"

decisions.choice: Isaiah 49:6, God's words to his servant
decisions.reason: In Isaiah the LORD, the divine name in the Hebrew, speaks to his servant. Simeon applied the words to Jesus (Luke 2:32). Here Paul and Barnabas take them as their own commission, since they carry the servant's light to the nations.

decisions.choice: nations: the peoples of the world, the Gentiles
decisions.reason: The same word is "Gentiles" in 13:46 and 13:48. In the quotation it keeps the sense of all the peoples.

decisions.choice: you: singular, the servant of the Lord
decisions.reason: The "you" is singular in Isaiah, and Paul and Barnabas say the Lord commanded "us".

decisions.choice: the end of the earth: the whole world
decisions.reason: The same words as Jesus's commission in 1:8.

decisions.choice: you will bring salvation to people all over the earth
alternatives: to be for salvation to the end of the earth
decisions.reason: Readable says the purpose in plain words.

decisions.choice: te, tú (singular), no plural_you span
decisions.reason: The "you" of the quotation is singular, the servant of the Lord (meaning decision m3), though Paul and Barnabas apply it to their mission; Spanish keeps the singular, so it takes no plural_you span.

decisions.choice: God speaks to his servant as "con" in Isaiah 49:6; "các dân ngoại" (L), "các dân tộc" (B, R), as in the Vietnamese Luke 2:32
decisions.reason: The "you" is singular, God's servant (meaning decision), and God speaks to his servant as he does to Abraham and Moses (7:3, 7:32-34). The Vietnamese Luke words the same promise with these words for the nations.

decisions.choice: "민족들의 빛" (L), "이방 사람들의 빛" (B), "모든 민족의 빛" (R); "땅끝"
decisions.reason: Isaiah 49:6, God's words to his servant (meaning decision), in 해라체; "you" is singular, so "너". The same Greek word is "nations" and "Gentiles" (meaning decision), and the levels follow the English. "땅끝" as in 1:8, the words this verse echoes.

source.text: ἀκούοντα δὲ τὰ ἔθνη ἔχαιρον καὶ ἐδόξαζον τὸν λόγον τοῦ κυρίου, καὶ ἐπίστευσαν ὅσοι ἦσαν τεταγμένοι εἰς ζωὴν αἰώνιον·

records.literal_gloss: Hearing [it] then the Gentiles were rejoicing and glorifying the word of the Lord, and believed as many as were appointed to life eternal;

en.L: And when the Gentiles heard [this], they were rejoicing and glorifying the word of the Lord, and as many as were appointed to eternal life believed.
en.B: When the Gentiles heard this, they rejoiced and glorified the word of the Lord, and all who had been appointed to eternal life believed.
en.R: The Gentiles were very happy when they heard this. They glorified the Lord for {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} word. And all the people God had chosen for eternal life believed.

es.L: Y oyendo [esto] los gentiles, se alegraban y glorificaban la palabra del Señor, y creyeron todos los que estaban destinados a [la] vida eterna.
es.B: Al oír esto, los gentiles se alegraron y glorificaron la palabra del Señor, y creyeron todos los que habían sido destinados a la vida eterna.
es.R: Los gentiles se pusieron muy contentos al oír esto. Glorificaron al Señor por {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} palabra. Y todos los que Dios había escogido para la vida eterna creyeron.

fr.L: Et les nations, entendant [cela], se réjouissaient et glorifiaient la parole du Seigneur, et crurent tous ceux qui étaient établis pour la vie éternelle.
fr.B: En entendant cela, les non-Juifs se réjouirent et glorifièrent la parole du Seigneur, et tous ceux qui avaient été désignés pour la vie éternelle crurent.
fr.R: Les non-Juifs ont été très heureux d’entendre cela. Ils ont glorifié le Seigneur pour {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} parole. Et tous ceux que Dieu avait choisis pour la vie éternelle ont cru.

sw.L: Na watu wa mataifa waliposikia [hayo], walikuwa wakifurahi na kulitukuza neno la Bwana, na wakaamini wote waliokuwa wamewekwa kwa ajili ya uzima wa milele.
sw.B: Watu wa mataifa waliposikia hayo, walifurahi na kulitukuza neno la Bwana, na wote waliokuwa wamewekwa kwa ajili ya uzima wa milele waliamini.
sw.R: Watu wa mataifa walifurahi sana waliposikia hayo. Walimtukuza Bwana kwa ajili ya neno {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}. Na wote ambao Mungu alikuwa amewachagua kwa ajili ya uzima wa milele waliamini.

vi.L: Các dân ngoại nghe vậy thì vui mừng và tôn vinh lời Chúa; và tất cả những người đã được định cho sự sống đời đời đều tin.
vi.B: Nghe vậy, các dân ngoại vui mừng và tôn vinh lời Chúa, và tất cả những người đã được định cho sự sống đời đời đều tin.
vi.R: Những người không phải Do Thái rất vui mừng khi nghe điều này. Họ tôn vinh Chúa vì lời của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Và tất cả những người Đức Chúa Trời đã chọn để nhận sự sống đời đời đều tin.

ko.L: 그러자 이방 사람들이 듣고 기뻐하며 주님의 말씀을 찬양했다. 그리고 영원한 생명을 얻도록 정해진 사람은 모두 믿었다.
ko.B: 이방 사람들은 이 말을 듣고 기뻐하며 주님의 말씀을 찬양했다. 그리고 영원한 생명을 얻도록 정해진 사람들은 모두 믿었다.
ko.R: 유대인이 아닌 사람들은 이 말을 듣고 몹시 기뻐했다. 그들은 주님의 말씀 때문에 주님을 찬양했다. 그리고 하나님께서 영원한 생명을 얻도록 택하신 사람들은 모두 믿었다.

decisions.choice: were appointed: a passive, appointed by God
alternatives: had set themselves toward eternal life
decisions.reason: The form is most naturally passive, and the one who appoints to eternal life is God. A middle sense, "had set themselves", has been proposed but is not the natural reading of the form.

decisions.choice: God's appointing and their believing go together
decisions.reason: Luke states that those appointed believed, without explaining how God's appointing and human believing relate. Paul has just urged his hearers to believe (13:39-41), and the Jews who refused judged themselves unworthy (13:46).

decisions.choice: eternal life: the life of the age to come
decisions.reason: The same phrase as in 13:46.

decisions.choice: glorifying the word of the Lord: praising God for the message
decisions.reason: They honored the message by praising God for it.

decisions.choice: the people God had chosen
decisions.reason: Readable names God as the one who appoints, as the meaning note explains.

decisions.choice: glorified the Lord for his word
alternatives: glorifying the word of the Lord
decisions.reason: Readable says what glorifying the word means, as the meaning note explains.

decisions.choice: "đã được định" (L, B) for "were appointed"
decisions.reason: A passive, appointed by God (meaning decision); Readable names God, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "정해진" (L, B) for the passive tetagmenoi; "하나님께서 ... 택하신" (R)
decisions.reason: Appointed by God (meaning decision); Literal and Balanced keep the passive, and Readable names God, as the English Readable does.

source.text: διεφέρετο δὲ ὁ λόγος τοῦ κυρίου δι’ ὅλης τῆς χώρας.

records.literal_gloss: Was carried through then the word of the Lord through all the region.

en.L: And the word of the Lord was being carried through the whole region.
en.B: And the word of the Lord spread across the whole region.
en.R: The word of the Lord spread to all the places around that city.

es.L: Y la palabra del Señor se difundía por toda la región.
es.B: Y la palabra del Señor se extendió por toda la región.
es.R: La palabra del Señor se extendió por todos los lugares alrededor de aquella ciudad.

fr.L: Et la parole du Seigneur était portée à travers toute la région.
fr.B: Et la parole du Seigneur se répandit dans toute la région.
fr.R: La parole du Seigneur s’est répandue dans tous les endroits autour de cette ville.

sw.L: Na neno la Bwana lilikuwa likienea katika nchi yote.
sw.B: Neno la Bwana likaenea katika eneo lote.
sw.R: Neno la Bwana lilienea katika sehemu zote za kandokando ya mji huo.

vi.L: Và lời Chúa được truyền ra khắp cả miền ấy.
vi.B: Lời Chúa lan truyền khắp cả miền ấy.
vi.R: Lời của Chúa lan truyền đến mọi nơi chung quanh thành ấy.

ko.L: 그리고 주님의 말씀이 온 지방에 퍼져 나갔다.
ko.B: 주님의 말씀이 그 온 지방에 퍼졌다.
ko.R: 주님의 말씀이 그 도시 주변의 모든 곳에 퍼졌다.

decisions.choice: the region: the country around Pisidian Antioch
decisions.reason: The city was the center of a wider district (13:50).

decisions.choice: was being carried: the message kept spreading
decisions.reason: The imperfect tense pictures an ongoing spread, as in 6:7 and 12:24.

source.text: οἱ δὲ Ἰουδαῖοι παρώτρυναν τὰς σεβομένας γυναῖκας τὰς εὐσχήμονας καὶ τοὺς πρώτους τῆς πόλεως καὶ ἐπήγειραν διωγμὸν ἐπὶ τὸν Παῦλον καὶ Βαρναβᾶν, καὶ ἐξέβαλον αὐτοὺς ἀπὸ τῶν ὁρίων αὐτῶν.

records.literal_gloss: The but Jews incited the worshiping women of honorable position and the leading [men] of the city, and they stirred up persecution against Paul and Barnabas and expelled them from the district of them.

en.L: But the Jews incited the worshiping women of high standing and the leading [men] of the city, and stirred up persecution against Paul and Barnabas, and threw them out of their district.
en.B: But the Jews stirred up the respected women who worshiped God and the leading men of the city; they started a persecution against Paul and Barnabas and drove them out of their district.
en.R: But the Jews there stirred up some important women who worshiped God. They also stirred up the leaders of the city. These people began to make trouble for Paul and Barnabas, and they forced them to leave the area.

es.L: Pero los judíos incitaron a las mujeres que adoraban [a Dios], las de alta posición, y a los principales de la ciudad, y levantaron una persecución contra Pablo y Bernabé, y los expulsaron de su territorio.
es.B: Pero los judíos incitaron a las mujeres respetadas que adoraban a Dios y a los hombres más importantes de la ciudad; desataron una persecución contra Pablo y Bernabé y los echaron de su territorio.
es.R: Pero los judíos de allí alborotaron a algunas mujeres importantes que adoraban a Dios. También alborotaron a los líderes de la ciudad. Esta gente empezó a causarles problemas a Pablo y a Bernabé, y los obligaron a irse de la región.

fr.L: Mais les Juifs excitèrent les femmes pieuses de haut rang et les premiers de la ville, et ils suscitèrent une persécution contre Paul et Barnabas, et les chassèrent de leur territoire.
fr.B: Mais les Juifs montèrent contre eux les femmes de la bonne société qui adoraient Dieu, ainsi que les notables de la ville ; ils déclenchèrent une persécution contre Paul et Barnabas et les chassèrent de leur territoire.
fr.R: Mais les Juifs de cette ville ont excité des femmes importantes qui adoraient Dieu. Ils ont aussi excité les chefs de la ville. Ces gens ont commencé à s’en prendre à Paul et à Barnabas, et ils les ont obligés à quitter la région.

sw.L: Lakini Wayahudi waliwachochea wanawake waliokuwa wakimwabudu [Mungu], wenye vyeo, na wakuu wa mji, wakaanzisha mateso dhidi ya Paulo na Barnaba, wakawafukuza kutoka mipakani mwao.
sw.B: Lakini Wayahudi waliwachochea wanawake wenye heshima waliomwabudu Mungu, pamoja na wanaume mashuhuri wa mji; wakaanzisha mateso dhidi ya Paulo na Barnaba, wakawafukuza kutoka katika eneo lao.
sw.R: Lakini Wayahudi wa huko waliwachochea wanawake fulani mashuhuri waliomwabudu Mungu. Pia waliwachochea viongozi wa mji. Watu hao walianza kuwataabisha Paulo na Barnaba, wakawalazimisha waondoke katika eneo hilo.

vi.L: Nhưng người Do Thái xúi giục các bà có địa vị cao thờ phượng Đức Chúa Trời và những người đứng đầu trong thành, khơi lên một cuộc bắt bớ chống lại Phao-lô và Ba-na-ba, và đuổi hai ông ra khỏi địa phận của họ.
vi.B: Nhưng người Do Thái xúi giục những phụ nữ thượng lưu thờ phượng Đức Chúa Trời và những người có thế lực trong thành. Họ khơi lên một cuộc bắt bớ chống lại Phao-lô và Ba-na-ba, và đuổi hai ông ra khỏi địa phận của họ.
vi.R: Nhưng những người Do Thái ở đó xúi giục một số phụ nữ quan trọng thờ phượng Đức Chúa Trời. Họ cũng xúi giục những người lãnh đạo của thành. Những người ấy bắt đầu gây khó dễ cho Phao-lô và Ba-na-ba, và buộc hai ông phải rời khỏi vùng ấy.

ko.L: 그러나 유대인들은 경건한 귀부인들과 그 성의 유력한 사람들을 선동하여, 바울과 바나바를 박해하게 하고 그들을 자기 지역에서 쫓아냈다.
ko.B: 그러나 유대인들은 하나님을 섬기는 귀부인들과 그 성의 지도층 인사들을 부추겨서, 바울과 바나바를 박해하게 했다. 그리고 그들을 그 지역에서 쫓아냈다.
ko.R: 그러나 그곳의 유대인들은 하나님을 섬기는 높은 신분의 여자들을 부추겼다. 그 도시의 지도자들도 부추겼다. 이 사람들은 바울과 바나바를 괴롭히기 시작했다. 그리고 그들을 그 지역에서 억지로 떠나게 했다.

decisions.choice: worshiping women of high standing: Gentile women of rank who attended the synagogue
decisions.reason: The word "worshiping" is used of Gentiles who worshiped Israel's God (16:14, 17:4). Such women could have influence with the leading men, perhaps their husbands.

decisions.choice: the leading men of the city: its chief citizens and officials
decisions.reason: The word means the first or most prominent men. Antioch was a Roman colony run by local magistrates.

decisions.choice: threw them out of their district: forced them to leave the city's territory
decisions.reason: The verb means to drive or throw out. Paul later came back to the city (14:21).

decisions.choice: the Jews there
decisions.reason: As at 13:45: the Jews of that city's synagogue, not all Jews.

decisions.choice: three sentences
decisions.reason: Readable breaks the sentence up.

decisions.choice: "các bà có địa vị cao thờ phượng Đức Chúa Trời" (L); "những phụ nữ thượng lưu thờ phượng Đức Chúa Trời" (B); "thờ phượng Đức Chúa Trời" for "sebomenoi" at every level (also 13:43)
decisions.reason: Gentile women of rank who attended the synagogue (meaning decision).

decisions.choice: "경건한 귀부인들" (L), "하나님을 섬기는 귀부인들" (B), "하나님을 섬기는 높은 신분의 여자들" (R); "유력한 사람들" (L), "지도층 인사들" (B)
decisions.reason: Gentile women of rank who attended the synagogue (meaning decision); "섬기다" for sebomai, as in 13:43.

source.text: οἱ δὲ ἐκτιναξάμενοι τὸν κονιορτὸν τῶν ποδῶν ἐπ’ αὐτοὺς ἦλθον εἰς Ἰκόνιον, οἵ τε μαθηταὶ ἐπληροῦντο χαρᾶς καὶ πνεύματος ἁγίου.

records.literal_gloss: They but having shaken off the dust of the feet against them went to Iconium, \v 52 the and disciples were filled with joy and with [the] Holy Spirit.

en.L: But they, having shaken off the dust of [their] feet against them, went to Iconium, \v 52 and the disciples were being filled with joy and with [the] Holy Spirit.
en.B: So the two shook the dust from their feet against them and went on to Iconium. \v 52 And the disciples went on being filled with joy and with the Holy Spirit.
en.R: So Paul and Barnabas shook the dust off their feet to warn the people who had rejected them. Then they went to the city of Iconium. \v 52 But the believers in Antioch were filled with joy and with the Holy Spirit.

es.L: Pero ellos, sacudiendo contra ellos el polvo de los pies, fueron a Iconio, \v 52 y los discípulos se llenaban de alegría y del Espíritu Santo.
es.B: Entonces los dos sacudieron contra ellos el polvo de sus pies y siguieron hacia Iconio. \v 52 Y los discípulos seguían llenos de alegría y del Espíritu Santo.
es.R: Así que Pablo y Bernabé se sacudieron el polvo de los pies como advertencia para los que los habían rechazado. Luego se fueron a la ciudad de Iconio. \v 52 Pero los discípulos de Antioquía estaban llenos de alegría y del Espíritu Santo.

fr.L: Mais eux, ayant secoué contre eux la poussière de leurs pieds, allèrent à Iconium, \v 52 et les disciples étaient remplis de joie et de l’Esprit Saint.
fr.B: Les deux hommes secouèrent contre eux la poussière de leurs pieds et se rendirent à Iconium. \v 52 Quant aux disciples, ils continuaient d’être remplis de joie et de l’Esprit Saint.
fr.R: Alors Paul et Barnabas ont secoué la poussière de leurs pieds, pour avertir les gens qui les avaient rejetés. Ensuite, ils sont allés dans la ville d’Iconium. \v 52 Mais les croyants d’Antioche étaient remplis de joie et de l’Esprit Saint.

sw.L: Lakini wao, wakiisha kuyakung'uta mavumbi ya miguu dhidi yao, walikwenda Ikonio, \v 52 na wanafunzi walikuwa wakijazwa furaha na Roho Mtakatifu.
sw.B: Basi wale wawili waliyakung'uta mavumbi ya miguu yao dhidi yao, wakaenda Ikonio. \v 52 Na wanafunzi waliendelea kujazwa furaha na Roho Mtakatifu.
sw.R: Kwa hiyo Paulo na Barnaba waliyakung'uta mavumbi ya miguu yao kama onyo kwa watu waliowakataa. Kisha wakaenda mji wa Ikonio. \v 52 Lakini wanafunzi wa huko Antiokia walijawa na furaha na Roho Mtakatifu.

vi.L: Hai ông phủi bụi chân mình để làm chứng nghịch lại họ, rồi đi đến Y-cô-ni; \v 52 còn các môn đồ thì được đầy dẫy niềm vui và Đức Thánh Linh.
vi.B: Vậy hai ông phủi bụi chân mình để phản đối họ, rồi đi tiếp đến Y-cô-ni. \v 52 Còn các môn đồ thì tiếp tục được đầy dẫy niềm vui và Đức Thánh Linh.
vi.R: Vì vậy Phao-lô và Ba-na-ba phủi bụi khỏi chân mình để cảnh cáo những người đã khước từ hai ông. Rồi hai ông đi đến thành Y-cô-ni. \v 52 Nhưng các môn đồ ở An-ti-ốt được đầy dẫy niềm vui và Đức Thánh Linh.

ko.L: 그러자 두 사람은 그들을 향하여 발의 먼지를 떨어 버리고 이고니온으로 갔다. \v 52 그리고 제자들은 기쁨과 성령으로 충만했다.
ko.B: 두 사람은 그들을 향하여 발의 먼지를 떨어 버리고 이고니온으로 갔다. \v 52 그리고 제자들은 계속 기쁨과 성령으로 가득 찼다.
ko.R: 바울과 바나바는 자기들을 거부한 사람들에게 경고하는 뜻으로 발의 먼지를 떨어 버렸다. 그리고 이고니온이라는 도시로 갔다. \v 52 그러나 안디옥에 있는 제자들은 기쁨과 성령으로 가득 찼다.

decisions.choice: shaking off the dust against them: a sign of leaving them to answer for their choice
decisions.reason: Jesus told his messengers to do this when a town would not receive them (Luke 9:5, 10:11). It was a warning, not a curse.

decisions.choice: the disciples: the new believers in Antioch
decisions.reason: Paul and Barnabas have just left. Luke turns to those who remained, who were glad in spite of the persecution.

decisions.choice: were being filled: kept on being filled
decisions.reason: The imperfect tense pictures an ongoing state.

decisions.choice: Iconium: a city about ninety miles east of Pisidian Antioch
decisions.reason: It lay on the main road east, in the province of Galatia. Paul's work there is told in 14:1-6.

decisions.choice: to warn the people who had rejected them; the believers in Antioch
decisions.reason: Readable says what the sign meant and who the disciples were, as the meaning notes explain.

decisions.choice: los discípulos de Antioquía
decisions.reason: The book-wide word "discípulos" at every level, where the English Readable says "believers"; Readable adds "de Antioquía" as the English does (meaning decision m2).

decisions.choice: wanafunzi wa huko Antiokia
decisions.reason: The book-wide word "wanafunzi" at every level, where the English Readable says "believers"; Readable adds where they were, as the English does (meaning decision m2).

decisions.choice: "phủi bụi chân mình để làm chứng nghịch lại họ" (L); "Y-cô-ni"
decisions.reason: A sign of leaving them to answer for their choice (meaning decision), as Jesus told his disciples to do (Luke 9:5); the Protestant form of the name.

decisions.choice: "발의 먼지를 떨어 버리다"; "이고니온", as in the Korean 2 Timothy 3:11; "제자들" at every level
decisions.reason: Shaking off the dust is a sign of leaving them to answer for their choice (meaning decision), as Jesus told the Twelve in the Korean Luke 9:5; "제자" kept at every level, as settled at 6:1.
